description: [Google Calendar] Create a calendar event with the full Google Events.insert body, including attendees, Google Meet conferencing, recurrence, reminders and all-day dates — the fields the simpler Create Event action cannot express. Use Create Event for a plain timed event; use this when you need guests or any structured field. start and end are objects: pass dateTime (ISO 8601, with timeZone) for a timed event, or date (YYYY-MM-DD) for an all-day event, never both. name.description: Human-readable connector name, e.g. 'Salesforce CRM'. Max 100 chars.

name: fastnPlatform__createEventSubscription
title: fastnPlatform__createEventSubscription
description: [Fastn Workspace] Create an event subscription. Registers an https endpoint for signed events (X-Fastn-Timestamp, X-Fastn-Signature = sha256=HMAC(secret, "<timestamp>.<body>"), X-Fastn-Event-Id). Deliveries retry with backoff for 24 hours; the event id never changes, so drop repeats by id. The secret (whsec_...) is returned ONCE. Private, internal and non-https URLs are refused. Owner, admin or developer of the partner org (not a customer workspace).

eventTypes.description: Event types to send. Empty or omitted: every account and setup-link event (connection.*, setup_link.*). connector.event, unified.event and workflow.event are sent only when listed.

connectors.description: connector.event only: send provider events from these connectors (slug or connector id). Empty or omitted: every connector.

providerEvents.description: connector.event only: send only these provider event names (as the connector lists them, e.g. leadgen). Empty or omitted: every event.

entities.description: unified.event only: send unified events for these entities only, as "category/entity" (e.g. crm/contact). Empty or omitted: every entity.

connectorCategories.description: connector.event, unified.event and workflow.event: send events from connectors in these catalog categories (e.g. project-management). An event matches when its connector is in connectors OR its connector's category is here. Both empty or omitted: every connector.

workflowEvents.description: workflow.event only: send only events workflow code emits under these names (fastn.events.emit("ticket.created", ...)). Empty or omitted: every name. The connectors filter applies too, matched against the connector the code named.

payloadTemplate.description: workflow.event only: send the body in the endpoint's own schema. { connectors?: { <connector slug or id>: schema }, default?: schema }, where schema is a JSON Schema object: { type: "object", properties: { <field>: { type?, "x-source"?: <dotted path into the event, e.g. payload.finding.id>, const?, default?, properties? } }, required?: [<field>] }. The event's connector picks the schema, else default. type (string, number, integer, boolean, object, array) converts what it can; an empty optional field is left out; an event that cannot fill a required field is not sent and its delivery records why. With no schema (or null) the standard body is sent. Headers are unchanged; the signature covers the body actually sent.

endOrgId.description: Only events about this customer (a child of the org): fastn's org id, or the id you gave the customer at creation (orgId / externalRef). Omit for every customer.

Unless defer_config is true, the widget's config template is cloned into a per-installation config. 400 when the target, tenant, widget, config or a pinned connection is not the caller's; 409 when a binding already exists for target + tenant + slug, or the widget allows a single activation per customer. Requires workflows.update.

target_type.description: The kind of resource this binding runs.

target_id.description: The id of the target resource; must belong to the caller's org for widget/workflow/trigger.

end_org_id.description: The tenant (end-org) this installation is for. Must be a tenant of the caller's org unless it equals the caller's own org id (admin-only mode).

widget_id.description: Optional widget id (must belong to the org) (nullable).

slug.description: Optional per-tenant multi-instance slug; defaults to '__default__'. Unique per target + tenant + slug.

connections.description: Optional connection pin map (connector slug to connection id); each connection must belong to the org or be platform-wide.

config_id.description: Optional config id to clone into a private per-installation copy (nullable).

name: fastnPlatform__createMockStub
title: fastnPlatform__createMockStub
description: [Fastn Workspace] Create a mock stub. Adds a stub that mock executions of the action return when the input matches inputMatchers. Requires connectors.update; 400 when name, response.status or response.body is missing.

connectorId.description: Disambiguates the connector when the slug is not unique to the caller.

name.description: Label for this test case (required, non-empty).

description.description: Optional description of the test case (nullable).

inputMatchers.description: Input field -> value the call must carry for this stub to match; none = default stub.

response.description: Canned response to return. Required with status and body.

name: fastnPlatform__createScheduler
title: fastnPlatform__createScheduler
description: [Fastn Workspace] Create a scheduler. Creates a scheduled trigger that fires its routes on a 5-field cron expression or a fixed rate (exactly one of cron or rate). runOnCreate=true also fires it once immediately; omitted or false waits for the schedule. A scheduler auto-disabled by repeated failures is re-enabled after reenableAfterMinutes. Requires events.create.

id.description: Optional caller-supplied scheduler id (1-200 chars). Omit to auto-generate.

endOrgId.description: The customer the trigger is for: fastn's org id, or the id you gave the customer at creation (orgId / externalRef). Omit when the caller is the customer.

cron.description: 5-field standard cron schedule. Provide either cron or rate, not both.

rate.description: Fixed-interval schedule { value, unit }. Provide either cron or rate, not both.

delayMinutes.description: Delay in minutes applied before each dispatch. Defaults to 0.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the cron is evaluated in. Defaults to UTC.

startsAt.description: ISO-8601 datetime before which the scheduler does not fire. Nullable.

dlqConfiguration.description: Dead-letter retry policy for failed dispatches.

routes.description: Route bindings this scheduler dispatches to on each tick.

reenableAfterMinutes.description: Minutes to wait before auto re-enabling after auto-disable (1-1440). Defaults to 30.

name: fastnPlatform__createSecret
title: fastnPlatform__createSecret
description: [Fastn Workspace] Create a secret. A type of json is validated as JSON on write and fastn.secrets.get() returns it parsed at workflow runtime; text (the default) round-trips the exact string. Value max 8192 characters.

name.description: Secret name. Must be UPPER_SNAKE_CASE, starting with a letter, max 100 chars

value.description: Secret value (1-8192 chars), stored AES-256-GCM encrypted

name: fastnPlatform__createSetupLink
title: fastnPlatform__createSetupLink
description: [Fastn Workspace] Create a setup link for widget installation. Generates a single-use URL where an end-org customer can install a widget (connect accounts + configure) without logging in. Lifetime defaults to SETUP_LINK_DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES (15) and can be set per link with expiresInMinutes up to SETUP_LINK_MAX_TTL_MINUTES (7 days). After the setup is completed the link token stays usable only SETUP_LINK_AFTER_COMPLETE_MINUTES (60) so the wizard can finish. The caller must be the partner org (passing endOrgId or externalRef) or the end-org itself (omit both or set useCallerOrg: true). With externalRef + createIfMissing the customer is created on first use (needs customers.create). When the widget opts in to the onSetupLinkCompleted hook, completing the link fires it in background mode with source "setup_link" and the link metadata.

widgetId.description: ID of the widget (wgt_*) to install for the end-org. Must be a widget the caller's org owns and that is enabled.

endOrgId.description: End-org (customer) org id to install the widget for. Must be a child tenant of the caller's org. Use instead of externalRef; omit and set useCallerOrg=true when the caller itself is the end-org.

useCallerOrg.description: When true, uses the caller's own org as the end-org instead of endOrgId. Requires the caller org to be an end_org with a parent, otherwise the call fails with 'Could not resolve partner org'.

label.description: Name shown on the setup page, e.g. the customer's business name. Defaults to the widget name followed by 'setup'.

connectionName.description: Suggested label for the account the customer connects (pre-fills 'Name this account'). Optional: empty or omitted means automatic naming.

externalRef.description: Your own id for the customer (stored as its external ref). Use instead of endOrgId; with createIfMissing the customer is created on first use.

createIfMissing.description: With externalRef: create the customer when none has that ref yet. Requires customers.create.

expiresInMinutes.description: Link lifetime in minutes. Omitted: 15. Up to the deployment maximum (7 days = 10080 by default); above it the call fails with SETUP_LINK_TTL_TOO_LONG.

allowAdditionalConnection.description: Offer a NEW account for each app even when the customer already has one (for example a second calendar), instead of reusing the existing connection.

metadata.description: Your own data (max 4KB JSON), returned on GET, in the setup_link.completed event and to the widget's onSetupLinkCompleted hook.

redirectUrl.description: Where the setup page sends the browser when setup finishes (adds status, setupId and installationId). Must match a URL registered in the org config key setupLinkRedirectUrls; omitted: the first registered URL.

name: fastnPlatform__createSyncJob
title: fastnPlatform__createSyncJob
description: [Fastn Workspace] Create sync job. Creates an active sync job for a connector entity (requires workflows.create). direction defaults to inbound; the name is derived from connectorId and entity.

connectorId.description: Connector ID to sync

name: fastnPlatform__createTenant
title: fastnPlatform__createTenant
description: [Fastn Workspace] Create customer organization. Creates an org. Partner-API callers register a customer (tenant) with just name + orgId + tier: orgId is the PARTNER'S identifier for the customer, stored as external_ref (fastn generates its own id), and tier (id or display name of an entry in the account's customer_tiers) is written to the org config. slug is derived from name when omitted.

name.description: Org display name (1-200 chars, no control characters)

orgId.description: Partner-supplied external reference for this customer org, stored as external_ref. Usable later as x-org-id / endOrgId.

external_ref.description: Alias of orgId. Rejected when it differs from orgId.

externalRef.description: Alias of orgId. Rejected when it differs from orgId.

tier.description: Customer tier: id or display name from the account's customer_tiers.

limits.description: Per-customer limit overrides layered over the tier's limits, e.g. {"connections": 2}. 0 means none allowed.

plan.description: Launch, Scale and Enterprise are the tiers on offer; 'growth' and 'free' are retired names still carried by existing orgs and still accepted.

type.description: Defaults to end_org for account callers (company for platform_admin). account is a legacy alias of company.

domain.description: Verified domain for company-type orgs (max 253 chars, valid domain format, must be unique among company orgs).

ownerEmail.description: REQUIRED when type resolves to company or partner — an account cannot exist without an owner. Ignored for end_org.

name: fastnPlatform__createTestCaseDraft
title: fastnPlatform__createTestCaseDraft
description: [Fastn Workspace] Create a test-case draft for human review. Stores proposed test cases as a pending draft (expires) and returns a reviewUrl the user opens to edit and approve them. Do not run the cases until GET /test-case-drafts/{id} reports status approved. Requires workflows.create.

scope.description: Free-text scope describing what the test cases cover (e.g. a workflow or connector name).

testCases.description: The proposed test cases for review.

name: fastnPlatform__createUnifiedCustomEntity
title: fastnPlatform__createUnifiedCustomEntity
description: [Fastn Workspace] Create an entity owned by the caller's org in a platform category (unified.customize). fromEntityId copies a visible entity's schema and enabled mappings, with the caller's extensions merged in.. Creates an entity owned by the caller's org in a platform category; fromEntityId copies a visible entity's schema and enabled mappings. Requires unified.customize. 400 for an unknown categoryId or fromEntityId.

name: fastnPlatform__createUnifiedCustomMapping
title: fastnPlatform__createUnifiedCustomMapping
description: [Fastn Workspace] Bind a connector mapping to one of the caller org's entities (unified.customize); same body as the platform catalog mapping. Binds a connector mapping to an entity the caller's org owns. Requires unified.customize. 409 when the connector is already mapped; 404 when the entity is not found.

name: fastnPlatform__createUnifiedRecord
title: fastnPlatform__createUnifiedRecord
description: [Fastn Workspace] Create a record from a canonical body via one provider. Creates a record from a canonical body (any JSON object, mapped to the provider's fields) through one resolved provider. Requires unified.execute; 400 when the body is not a JSON object.

entity.description: Entity slug within the category, e.g. contacts.

provider.description: Connector slug to pin the call to. Omitted or empty = resolve from the caller's connected providers. 400 when not a connector slug.

connection_id.description: Which of the provider's connections to run against, when the org holds several accounts on the same connector. Ids come from GET /connections; one outside the caller's scope is rejected, not silently ignored.

widget_id.description: Widget whose unified config values (per connector) are applied to the call; ignored when the widget is not visible to the caller.

record.description: The record to create, keyed by canonical field name (for example {"firstName": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"}). The accepted keys are the entity's createFields from List Unified Categories; any other key fails validation.

idempotencyKey.description: The header field "Idempotency-Key". Makes a retry safe: the same key on this route for the same org and customer answers from the first run for 24 hours (Idempotent-Replayed: true) instead of calling the provider again. A key still in flight is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS; the same key sent with a different query string or body is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

fastnCorrelationId.description: The header field "X-Fastn-Correlation-Id". Your own id for this request (a call, a job). Echoed back, and the call is recorded under it: GET /api/v1/unified/calls?correlation_id=...

installationId.description: The header field "x-installation-id". Installation whose widget config values (unifiedValues) apply to this call. Omit for a call with no widget identity.

endOrgId.description: The header field "x-end-org-id". Partner callers only: run the call for this customer (end-org id) and its connections. Must be a customer of the caller's org (403 otherwise); not with x-end-org-ref (400). Omitted = the caller's own scope, unchanged.

endOrgRef.description: The header field "x-end-org-ref". Partner callers only: run the call for the customer registered under this external ref. 404 when the caller has no such customer; not with x-end-org-id (400).

name: fastnPlatform__createWebhookConfig
title: fastnPlatform__createWebhookConfig
description: [Fastn Workspace] Create a webhook config. Adds a webhook config to a connector: EVENT_WEBHOOK (subscription code registers the webhook with the provider) or APP (manually registered, routed by eventKey). Requires connectors.create.

type.description: APP for app-event triggers; EVENT_WEBHOOK for generic event webhooks.

subscription.description: JS subscription code (export default async function (ctx)). Max 500000 chars.

events.description: Event definitions: [{ id, label, description?, payloadSchema? }]. Defaults to [].

inputs.description: Input definitions passed to subscription code: [{ key, value, hidden? }]. Defaults to [].

requiredActions.description: Actions the subscription code calls: [{ actionId, label, value, mappedTo? }]. Defaults to [].

authProviderId.description: OAuth provider id to authenticate subscription calls with.

eventKey.description: JSON path used to extract the event type from incoming payloads. Max 200 chars.

verification.description: Signature/challenge verification config. Nullable. Shape: { eventsVerification: { method: HMAC|CHALLENGE_RESPONSE|NONE|VERIFICATION_TOKEN, signatureHeader?, algorithm?, timestampHeader?, maxTimestampAgeMs?, signaturePrefix?, signatureFormat?: hex|stripe, signingPayload?: body|hubspot_v1|hubspot_v2|hubspot_v3|slack_v0|stripe_v1 }, challengeDetection?: { field, value, responseField }, tokenHandshake?: { field }, getChallenge?: { source?: query|header, param?, verifyParam?, responseType?: text|json, responseField? } }. method HMAC and VERIFICATION_TOKEN BOTH require verificationSecret in the same call or the request is rejected 400. Do not ship method NONE to work around that - an unverified inbound webhook is accepted from anyone. Known limits: signatureFormat has no base64 option and signingPayload has no Standard-Webhooks/Svix option, so base64-HMAC-SHA1 and Svix-signed providers cannot be expressed here yet.

verificationSecret.description: The provider's webhook signing secret, stored vault-encrypted (max 4096 chars). REQUIRED whenever eventsVerification.method is HMAC or VERIFICATION_TOKEN. This is a single literal held on the webhook config, so it is per-connector, not per-connection - a provider that issues a different signing secret to every customer cannot be modelled here yet.

enabled.description: Whether the webhook config is active. Defaults to true.

name: fastnPlatform__createWebhookTrigger
title: fastnPlatform__createWebhookTrigger
description: [Fastn Workspace] Create a webhook trigger. Creates an inbound webhook trigger and returns its public triggerUrl, which is what you hand to the external system. routes bind it to workflows; a trigger created with no routes accepts events and delivers them nowhere (the response carries a warning). authMethod API_KEY (default) makes callers send a fastn API key. endOrgId creates it for a tenant of the caller's org. A custom id must be URL-safe; a taken id is a 409. Requires events.create.

id.description: Optional caller-supplied trigger id (1-200 chars). Omit to auto-generate.

endOrgId.description: The customer the trigger is for: fastn's org id, or the id you gave the customer at creation (orgId / externalRef). Omit when the caller is the customer.

authMethod.description: Inbound auth requirement for the webhook URL.

routeExecutionMode.description: Whether bound routes are dispatched in parallel or sequentially.

dlqConfiguration.description: Dead-letter retry policy for failed dispatches.

additionalConfig.description: Arbitrary key/value config. May include uniquePayloadFieldPath. Nullable.

routes.description: Route bindings this webhook dispatches inbound payloads to.

name: fastnPlatform__createWidget
title: fastnPlatform__createWidget
description: [Fastn Workspace] Create an embed widget; unified_refs attaches unified catalog entities (their mapped connectors join the manifest; no config template is created). trigger_categories defines named trigger groups (unique slugs) the installer picks from at activation; trigger_refs[].categories tags each template with those slugs (untagged = core, always provisioned). connector_refs[].connectionScope tags a registered SaaS connector with the connection scope activation must pin (registry-validated).. Creates a widget in the caller's org (requires widgets.create). Idempotent by name: a live widget with the same name (case-insensitive) is returned with 200 and reused: true instead of a new one. 400 when a trigger ref names an unknown category or a connection scope is invalid.

name.description: Display name for the embed widget. 1-100 characters.

description.description: Optional summary of what the widget does. Max 500 characters.

connector_ids.description: Legacy form: bare connector ids the widget exposes. Send an empty array for a unified-only widget.

connectionScope.description: SaaS-connector connection scope: activation pins the tenant's connection with this scope (400 when the tenant has none) and the customer connect flow hides this connector. Must be in the org's saas_connectors registry for this connector. Not the OAuth scopes.

connector_refs.description: Typed form of connector_ids, allowing per-connector auth overrides.

workflow_ids.description: Legacy form: bare workflow ids the widget exposes.

workflow_refs.description: Typed form of workflow_ids, pinning a specific version.

trigger_ids.description: Legacy form: bare trigger ids the widget exposes.

trigger_refs.description: Typed form of trigger_ids, controlling what the end user may edit.

trigger_categories_title.description: Heading for the activation wizard's sync-type selection step; null uses the built-in 'What do you want to sync?'.

unified_refs.description: Unified API entities the widget exposes, each fanned out across the listed providers. Supplying this alone is sufficient - connector_ids may be empty.

agent_context.description: JSON string passed to the AI assistant as context, e.g. {"scope":"org"}. Max 2000 characters.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Defaults to draft when omitted.

sync_direction.description: Which way data moves for this widget.

style_overrides.description: Map of CSS custom property name to value for theming the embed.

form_schema.description: JSON Schema for a custom configuration form rendered inside the widget.

activation_mode.description: Whether a customer activates once or holds many connections.

enabled.description: Whether the widget is live for end users.

allowed_end_org_ids.description: Restrict the widget to these tenants. Null or omitted means all.

name: fastnPlatform__createWorkflow
title: fastnPlatform__createWorkflow
description: [Fastn Workspace] Create workflow. Creates a workflow (requires workflows.create). The connector manifest is extracted from `code` and merged with any connectorManifest entries sent. 409 when a live workflow in the org already has the slug; 403 quota_exceeded when the org holds its plan's workflow cap; 403 WF-CODE-READONLY when the org may read but not write workflow code.

inputSchema.description: REQUIRED. JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for ctx.input — type/properties/required derived from a representative example payload. Use {"type":"object","properties":{},"required":[]} only when the workflow truly takes no input.

enabled.description: Set true to enable the workflow.

testCases.description: REQUIRED. The user-approved test cases covering the workflow's logic. Each case should carry its executable fixture (input/headers/mockScenarios) so any agent can replay it verbatim via testSavedWorkflow. On update, pass the current set from getWorkflow when unchanged.

testInput.description: REQUIRED. JSON text saved as the Test panel's ctx.input default (max 64KB). Pass the same example the inputSchema was derived from; "{}" when the workflow takes no input.

testHeaders.description: REQUIRED. JSON text saved as the Test panel's ctx.headers default (max 64KB), e.g. {"x-end-org-id":"..."} for multi-tenant workflows; "{}" when no headers are needed.

name: fastnPlatform__createWorkflowCategory

name.description: Label name, 1-32 chars, unique per workspace (case-insensitive).

colour.description: Palette token name, one of: chart-1, chart-2, chart-3, brand, success, info, warning, danger

name: fastnPlatform__deleteWebhookTrigger

name: fastnPlatform__deleteWorkflowCategory

title: fastnPlatform__disconnectGithubIntegration

name: fastnPlatform__editWorkflowCode
title: fastnPlatform__editWorkflowCode
description: [Fastn Workspace] Edit workflow code by exact string replacement. Replaces oldString with newString in the workflow's current code and publishes the result as a new version immediately (requires workflows.update). oldString must occur exactly once unless replaceAll is true (409 on multiple matches, 404 when absent). The response carries a regressionGate when the workflow has test cases to re-run. 403 WF-CODE-READONLY when the org may read but not write workflow code.

id.description: The workflow's id (wf_*). Returns 404 when not found in the caller's org.

oldString.description: The exact code snippet to replace. Must appear in the workflow's draft or published code; returns 404 when absent and 409 when it matches multiple times without replaceAll.

newString.description: Defaults to an empty string; must differ from oldString.

replaceAll.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a single unique match.

name: fastnPlatform__ensureExecutionSummary
title: fastnPlatform__ensureExecutionSummary
description: [Fastn Workspace] Get or write a run's plain-language summary. For a completed run that skipped records: answers the stored plain-language summary, writing it on the first call (copied from an earlier run with the same issues when there is one, otherwise generated by the model). Later calls are free. `data` is null when the run has nothing to summarize or the summary could not be written. When writing takes longer than the request waits (20 s), the answer is `{ data: null, pending: true }` and the write continues; ask again to get it.

name: fastnPlatform__executeAction
title: fastnPlatform__executeAction
description: [Fastn Workspace] Execute a connector action. Runs one action by id against a connection and returns the provider's response. The gateway forwards the body unchanged to the connector runtime (UCL for a migrated org), which requires connectors.read. Name the connection with connectorId + connectionName, or pin it with connectionId / installationId; mockMode runs a stub instead of calling the provider.

connectorId.description: Connector the action belongs to. Required unless mockMode is true.

connectionName.description: Display name of the connection to run with. Required by the legacy connector service unless mockMode is true.

connectionId.description: Pin an exact connection. A hard constraint: an unusable id fails rather than falling back.

installationId.description: Run with the connection bound to this installation.

input.description: Action input, validated against the action's inputContract.

externalVersion.description: External contract version of the action to run.

versionMajor.description: Internal major version of the action to run.

mockMode.description: Run against the action's mock stubs instead of the provider. No credential is used.

name: fastnPlatform__executeWebhookSubscription
title: fastnPlatform__executeWebhookSubscription
description: [Fastn Workspace] Run a webhook subscription. Runs the config's subscription code for one event, registering webhookUrl (which must be a public host) with the provider. Requires connectors.update.

id.description: ID of the webhook config (path parameter).

eventId.description: The event id to subscribe (must exist in the config's events).

webhookUrl.description: Must point to a public host.

additionalInputs.description: Extra string→string inputs merged into the subscription input.

name: fastnPlatform__executeWorkflow
title: fastnPlatform__executeWorkflow
description: [Fastn Workspace] Execute workflow. Behaviour depends on the workflow's executionTier, and callers must handle both. STANDARD and LONG queue the run and return 202 with an executionId to poll. INSTANT runs synchronously and returns 200 with the finished result — it holds the HTTP request for the duration, which is the point of the tier, so there is nothing to poll. On the instant path the id appears ONLY in the X-Execution-Id response header — the body is the workflow's own return value and has nowhere to put it — so use that header to correlate a synchronous run. The queued path does not set that header; its id is in data.executionId. A caller written to poll unconditionally will break on an instant-tier workflow. An instant timeout on a workflow with escalateOnTimeout also returns 202, naming the escalated standard run in escalatedTo/escalatedFrom. Send Idempotency-Key to make a retry safe: a duplicate returns the existing execution for the same tenant instead of running again — 200 once it has finished, 202 while it is still in flight — and resolves to the escalated run where a timeout escalated.

idempotencyKey.description: The header field "Idempotency-Key". Client-supplied dedup key. Scoped to the execution's (owner org, end-org); no expiry window beyond the execution's retention. The prefix fastn-event: is reserved for trigger dispatch and is refused with 400 (reserved_idempotency_key); keys with it replay only an in-flight or completed run from the last 24 hours. Rarely, concurrent requests under one key are answered 503 (idempotency_key_contended) with nothing created; retry. A fastn-event: key whose run exists but was not yet handed to an engine is answered 409 (dispatch_run_not_started); retry.

fastnEnv.description: The header field "x-fastn-env". Which environment to execute against, and therefore WHICH CODE RUNS. 'test' runs the workflow's latest published version; any other slug runs the version actively deployed to that environment. Omitted, it defaults to the credential's own mode: a fsk_test_ key gets 'test', a fsk_live_ key gets 'live'. A test key may ONLY name 'test' — asking for anything else is refused with 403 ENV_NOT_PERMITTED rather than quietly downgraded, so a 200 always means the environment you asked for is the one that ran. A live key pinned to an environment (workflowEnvId) defaults to that environment, may also name 'test', and is refused for any other. A live key made before keys were pinned may name any environment, including 'test'.

name: fastnPlatform__fetchWebPage
title: fastnPlatform__fetchWebPage

url.description: The absolute http or https URL to fetch. Private, internal, and loopback hosts are rejected with 400.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of text to return. Clamped to 1-200000; defaults to 50000.

name: fastnPlatform__forkConfig
title: fastnPlatform__forkConfig

endOrgId.description: Partner preview: act for this tenant as its embed would

name: fastnPlatform__forkConnector
title: fastnPlatform__forkConnector
description: [Fastn Workspace] Fork a parent's custom connector into your own org, secrets included. Copies the connector with its actions, action folders, auth methods, OAuth providers (client secrets included), webhook configs and app registrations, keeping its slug so your workflows resolve to the copy. Requires connectors.create. A shared catalog connector answers 400 FORK_CONNECTOR_CATALOG: every org already uses the same one.

id.description: The provider's connector id to fork.

endOrgId.description: Partner preview: act for this tenant as its embed would

name: fastnPlatform__forkIntegration
title: fastnPlatform__forkIntegration
description: [Fastn Workspace] Fork (duplicate) an inherited integration into your own org so you can customise it. For a child org (a tenant) whose parent offers an integration (widget) it wants to change. The parent's integration can never be modified from a child org; this copies it into the caller's org and the copy is fully the caller's to edit. Copies the widget, its config template, every workflow it runs (lifecycle hooks, trigger targets, config option sources and every sub-flow they invoke, published, and deployed wherever the source is live), everything those workflows read by org at run time (env config values, secrets, the configs they name, the environments they run in), their category, labels, documentation and validation, its trigger templates (webhook, schedule and app-event, routed to the copied workflows, with the webhook configs and app registrations app events need) and the parent's CUSTOM connectors with their actions, auth methods, entities, mock stubs and OAuth providers including client secrets. Catalog connectors are shared by every org and stay referenced; so do all connectors when the caller's role cannot author connectors (end_user) - the response lists them in sharedConnectorIds. Every id is rewritten so the copy points at the copies. The parent's integration stays where it is and existing installations of it keep running. The customer sees ONE integration with two versions, their copy and the original: the copy becomes the active version, unless they already run the original, which then stays active until they switch (setWidgetActiveVersion). Idempotent: forking again returns the existing copies (200), and a fork that failed part-way resumes when repeated. Pass ?endOrgId=<tenant> from a partner session to fork into that tenant. Use it when the caller wants to change an integration whose orgId is not their own org; ask them first. Afterwards change ONLY the copies named in data.items (type workflow: updateWorkflow or editWorkflowCode, then publishWorkflow, then run it), never the original ids. Tell the caller which connectors stay shared (sharedConnectorIds) and relay warnings. A copy deployed to live keeps running the previous version for live traffic until it is deployed again. If the customer already has a copy (a widget in listWidgets with version.kind = custom), change THAT copy; forking again returns it. If the original is still their active version, offer to switch (setWidgetActiveVersion): switching pauses their setup on the original and moves it to the copy with the same connected accounts.

endOrgId.description: Partner preview: fork into this tenant as its embed would

name.description: Name for the copy; defaults to the original's name

name: fastnPlatform__forkTrigger
title: fastnPlatform__forkTrigger

A copied schedule does not run on create.

id.description: The provider's trigger template id to fork.

endOrgId.description: Partner preview: act for this tenant as its embed would

name: fastnPlatform__forkWidget

id.description: The provider's widget id to fork.

endOrgId.description: Partner preview: act for this tenant (validated against the caller's org chain) as its embed would.

name: fastnPlatform__forkWorkflow

Copies the parent's PUBLISHED code under the same slug (sub-flows are called by slug), publishes the copy and deploys it to every environment the source is live in that your org also has. Connector pins are dropped and connectors re-resolve in your org. The workflow must be reachable by your org (on an integration offered to it, or installed for it).

id.description: The provider's workflow id to fork.

endOrgId.description: Partner preview: act for this tenant as its embed would

name: fastnPlatform__getEnvConfig

name: fastnPlatform__getEventSubscription

executionId.description: Execution ID. From List workflow executions.

name: fastnPlatform__getExecutionLogs
title: fastnPlatform__getExecutionLogs
description: [Fastn Workspace] Get an execution's log lines from Loki. The run's fastn.loki lines and mirrored console.* lines, read back from Grafana Loki: the most recent `limit` lines, returned oldest first. A run past its hourly shipping budget (5000 lines an hour) has a warn line for each hour it dropped lines, saying how many. Scoped exactly like the execution detail route. Lines an inline sub-flow (fastn.flow.invoke) wrote are included, each naming its own executionId. Never a 5xx for Loki trouble: when Loki is not configured (LOKI_QUERY_URL unset) or the query fails the answer is 200 with available: false and a reason, and the run's stored console lines remain on the detail route. A role without workflows.execute gets available: false, reason: redacted, as for every other run body.

limit.description: Lines to return. Absent or blank uses the default; anything outside 1-5000 is a 400.

The installation's trigger templates (from its widget) and the live trigger instances made from them. Requires events.read.

name: fastnPlatform__getMyOrgDomain
title: fastnPlatform__getMyOrgDomain

name: fastnPlatform__getMySuggestions
title: fastnPlatform__getMySuggestions
description: [Fastn Workspace] Personalized home-screen suggestions for the caller's org. Four org-specific integration suggestions for the home screen, derived from the company's domain research, the integration-complaint corpus, and what the org has connected, built and asked the build agent about. Org-scoped: every member reads the same set, regardless of who onboarded. Regeneration is fired in the background when the set is missing or older than 3 days and is never awaited — the response always returns what is stored, which may be an empty array. Requires operator or above, matching the roles that can launch the orchestrator.

name: fastnPlatform__getOnboardingProductProfile
title: fastnPlatform__getOnboardingProductProfile

Returns the product profile the caller's default org confirmed during onboarding (what SaaS research found, as corrected), or null; suggestedDomain is the sign-up email's domain unless it is a personal one. Signed-in dashboard user (Bearer JWT); end_user is refused.

name: fastnPlatform__getOrgConfig
title: fastnPlatform__getOrgConfig

name: fastnPlatform__getSaasResearch
title: fastnPlatform__getSaasResearch
description: [Fastn Workspace] Get SaaS research for a domain. Reads the research for a domain started with researchSaas. 200 status "ready" with the report; 202 status "running" (poll again after pollAfterSeconds); 200 status "failed" with error (call researchSaas again to retry; profile is included when the run got that far); 200 status "stale" with the old report when it has no profile or is older than 30 days (call researchSaas to research it again); 404 when the domain was never researched. A running poll carries progress and, once progress.profileReady, the profile. Reading never starts a run. Roles: owner, admin, developer, operator.

name: fastnPlatform__getScheduler

name: fastnPlatform__getSetupJourney

description: [Fastn Workspace] Get the setup journey state. Returns the caller's default org's setup journey for its first integration: status (in_progress while in the guided screens, skipped once they leave for the platform, completed), step 1-4 (connect your product, choose integrations, embed the widget, customers connect), the last screen, the setup mode and AI tool, the product profile from step 1, the agent threads building it, the step 2 choice, widgetId, and widgetLoadedAt / widgetLoadedOn: when and on which host the embedded widget first loaded outside the dashboard (written by the server when the iframe is served, never by this PUT), and creditGrants: the AI credits each finished step has granted ({ step, credits, grantedAt }). orgId is null when the user has no default membership yet. Signed-in dashboard user (Bearer JWT); end_user is refused.

name: fastnPlatform__getTriggerStats
title: fastnPlatform__getTriggerStats

name: fastnPlatform__getTriggersMonitoring

description: [Fastn Workspace] Org-wide trigger health. Health overview of every trigger (webhook, scheduler, app event) in the caller's org: pipeline counters, per-trigger delivery stats, DLQ depth and circuit-breaker state, with a computed health. order=oldest surfaces the longest-waiting triggers and is single-page (a cursor with it is a 400).

name: fastnPlatform__getUnifiedCatalogEntity
title: fastnPlatform__getUnifiedCatalogEntity

name: fastnPlatform__getUnifiedRecord

description: [Fastn Workspace] Get one canonical record by remote id. Fetches one canonical record by the provider's remote id through one resolved provider. Requires unified.read.

name: fastnPlatform__getWebhookTrigger

name: fastnPlatform__getWidget
title: fastnPlatform__getWidget

include.description: inherited: let a platform_admin acting in a child org read the direct parent's widget.

name: fastnPlatform__getWidgetEmbedStatus
title: fastnPlatform__getWidgetEmbedStatus
description: [Fastn Workspace] Which of your customers have the widget embedded in their product. One entry per customer of the partner (its direct children, whatever their org type), each with whether the widget is embedded in that customer's product. A sighting is recorded when that customer's embed session (a tenant-scoped embed token; not a share link or any scoped setup/connect link) lists its widgets from a page whose host is known, from the request Origin or, on the iframe path, the frame's Referer. A widget URL opened in a tab of its own is not counted. Only the partner's own widgets are recorded. status is active when last seen within activeWindowDays, inactive when seen before that, never when not seen (with widgetId, when that widget was not seen). host is the partner page it was last seen on. widgets lists each widget that customer's hub served, with its own first and last sighting. lastSeenAt is coarse: at most one write per customer every few minutes. At most 2000 customers, most recently seen first then never-seen by name; truncated is true when there were more. For each SaaS partner to track its own customers: requires widgets.read and an account-tier role (owner, admin, developer) acting as the partner. A tenant-scoped session (embed token, tenant-pinned or customer-scoped API key) and operator, viewer and end_user are refused.

widgetId.description: Only customers whose hub served this widget

name: fastnPlatform__getWidgetInsights
title: fastnPlatform__getWidgetInsights
description: [Fastn Workspace] Widget/workflow operational rollup. Run and record counts come from pre-aggregated rollups, so any window up to 365 days answers in milliseconds. Every window is whole calendar days in `tz`: a preset of N days is today plus the N-1 days before it; `from`/`to` are exactly those days.

days.description: Custom length in days, ending today. Overrides range.

from.description: Start of a calendar window (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Must be sent with `to`; overrides range/days.

to.description: End of the window (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive of the whole day). Must be sent with `from`.

tz.description: IANA zone the window's days are in; UTC when omitted or unrecognised.

name: fastnPlatform__initiateOauthConnection
title: fastnPlatform__initiateOauthConnection
description: [Fastn Workspace] Start an OAuth connection. Starts an OAuth connect (or reconnect, with connectionId) for a connector and returns the provider authorization URL to open in a browser. UCL completes the flow, stores the connection and redirects to returnUrl. connectionName (optional, max 64) names a NEW account; a name another active account of this connector already uses is refused with 409 CONNECTION_NAME_TAKEN, and without it the auto name (default, connection-1, ...) is kept. setupLinkId (optional) is sent by the setup page so the connection.connected event carries that link's metadata. Requires connections.create.

connectorId.description: ID of the connector to connect.

authMethodId.description: ID of the OAuth auth method to use.

authProviderId.description: OAuth provider selected at connection time.

connectionName.description: Name to give the resulting connection.

scopes.description: User-selected scope strings for this connection.

returnUrl.description: Frontend page to redirect back to after OAuth.

dashboardOrigin.description: Full origin URL of the dashboard.

oauthVariables.description: Values for {key} placeholders in the OAuth URLs (string→string).

endOrgId.description: Admin preview: create the connection under this tenant.

source.description: Set to 'mcp' so the callback closes the tab instead of redirecting to the dashboard.

name: fastnPlatform__listActions
title: fastnPlatform__listActions
description: [Fastn Workspace] List actions. Actions of the connectors visible to the caller, or of one connector. The default light view omits contracts; view=contracts adds input/output contracts and view=full returns everything (use it only for a single connector). deleted=true (the trash) needs connectors.delete. Requires connectors.read.

connectorId.description: Filter actions by connector id (query param). This is how an eligible credential verification action is found: list the connector's actions with view=full, then keep those whose httpConfig.method is GET or HEAD and whose inputContract.required is empty.

view.description: Projection: omit for lightweight (httpConfig present, inputContract null), 'contracts' to include inputContract (httpConfig omitted), 'full' for all heavy columns. Finding a credential verification candidate needs both httpConfig.method and inputContract.required, so it requires view=full - neither of the other two projections returns both fields.

order.description: resolver: the version-resolution order instead of by name.

name: fastnPlatform__listAlerts
title: fastnPlatform__listAlerts
description: [Fastn Workspace] List alert rules. Lists the alert rules in the caller's scope (newest first, 200 max). An end_user sees only their tenant's rules. Roles: owner, admin, developer, end_user.

endOrgId.description: Act on this tenant's own alert rules ("view as tenant"). Alerts are not inherited: each org has its own.

name: fastnPlatform__listAppEventTriggers
title: fastnPlatform__listAppEventTriggers
description: [Fastn Workspace] List app-event triggers. Lists app-event triggers (triggers fired by a connector's events, e.g. a HubSpot contact.created) in the caller's org, newest first, cursor-paginated. Each row carries its ingest webhookUrl and the provider-side subscriptionStatus. Requires events.read.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response's meta.nextCursor.

status.description: Filter by trigger status, e.g. ACTIVE or DISABLED.

connectorId.description: Filter to triggers for a specific connector UUID.

end_org_id.description: Only one customer's triggers: fastn's org id, or the id you gave the customer at creation (orgId / externalRef).

name: fastnPlatform__listAuthMethods
title: fastnPlatform__listAuthMethods
description: [Fastn Workspace] List auth methods. Auth methods of the connectors visible to the caller, or of one connector. Requires connectors.read.

connectorId.description: Filter auth methods by connector id (query param, optional).

name: fastnPlatform__listAuthProviders
title: fastnPlatform__listAuthProviders
description: [Fastn Workspace] List auth providers. OAuth apps visible to the caller (its own org's and the shared catalog's), without client secrets. Requires connectors.read.

connectorId.description: Filter providers by connector id (query param, optional).

name: fastnPlatform__listConfigs
title: fastnPlatform__listConfigs
description: [Fastn Workspace] List configs. Lists integration configs (field mappings, conditions, defaults, matching) in the caller's scope. With widget_id, an embed tenant also gets the template its ancestor workspace defined for that widget. Requires widgets.read.

widget_id.description: Optional widget id to filter configs by.

end_org_id.description: Tenant whose per-installation configs to list.

name: fastnPlatform__listConnections
title: fastnPlatform__listConnections
description: [Fastn Workspace] List connections. Connections the caller can reach: their own pool, plus their child tenants' for admin/owner. Credentials are never returned. Each row carries endOrgId and endOrgName so a cross-customer list can name the customer it belongs to.

endOrgId.description: Customer whose connections to list: fastn's org id, or the id you gave the customer at creation (orgId / externalRef). Omit for the caller's own pool.

orgId.description: Alternate spelling of the customer org (the customer detail page uses this). Takes the same values as endOrgId.

userId.description: Filter to one external user reference.

connectionScope.description: Filter by SaaS-connector connection scope (e.g. inventory). Distinct from scope=saasPool.

scope.description: Which pool. saasPool = the caller's own connections. customers = every child tenant's connections and none of the caller's own (the partner Connections page's customer view) - account-tier roles only, and refused for a tenant-scoped session.

includePartnerPool.description: Include the partner's shared pool alongside a customer's own rows.

name: fastnPlatform__listConnectorEvents
title: fastnPlatform__listConnectorEvents
description: [Fastn Workspace] List a connector's subscribable events. The event catalog an app-event trigger can subscribe to for this connector: events from its webhook configs (with whether each is registered) merged with those from its app registration. Use the ids in createAppEventTrigger. Requires events.read.

connectorId.description: Connector UUID (the id field from the connectors list), not the slug.

name: fastnPlatform__listConnectors
title: fastnPlatform__listConnectors
description: [Fastn Workspace] List connectors. The connector catalog visible to the caller: its own org's connectors, the shared library and what its parent org offers it. slug resolves one connector exactly (own org first, then ancestors, then the shared library). deleted=true (the trash) needs connectors.delete. Requires connectors.read.

slug.description: Exact slug lookup; returns at most one connector.

categoryKey.description: Browse-taxonomy key (see @fastn/core CONNECTOR_CATEGORIES: crm-sales, communication, ai-ml, ...). NOT the `category` field on the connector, which carries the tier. An unrecognised key is ignored and the full list is returned.

labels.description: Comma-separated labels; a connector must carry them.

includeDeleted.description: Include soft-deleted rows alongside live ones.

deleted.description: Trash view: only soft-deleted rows the caller's user or org owns.

orgId.description: platform_admin only: org_platform lists only the managed catalog.

cursor.description: Opaque page cursor (from the previous page); not available to a resource-scoped token.

name: fastnPlatform__listDiffReports
title: fastnPlatform__listDiffReports
description: [Fastn Workspace] List fastn.diff sync run reports (per-run created/updated/deleted/unchanged stats plus capped field-level change details), newest first. Evidence for what a sync run actually changed.

before.description: Only reports created before this ISO instant (keyset paging)

name: fastnPlatform__listEnvironmentConfigs
title: fastnPlatform__listEnvironmentConfigs
description: [Fastn Workspace] List environment configs. Every env-config key of the org with its value per environment slug (requires settings.read). Env-configs are plain, non-secret values read by running workflows; use secrets for credentials.

name: fastnPlatform__listEnvironments
title: fastnPlatform__listEnvironments
description: [Fastn Workspace] List workflow environments. The org's workflow environments, ordered default first, then oldest first, then by id as a tiebreak (environments created together in one bulk call share a creation timestamp, so id is what makes the order total). Includes the built-in Live environment (slug 'live', isDefault true, isDeletable false), which every workflow-authoring org is seeded at creation — it is a real row, and its id is what /workflows/{id}/deploy and /workflows/{id}/promote accept. A customer workspace (end_org) is deliberately not seeded one and can legitimately return an empty list. 'test' is a separate hardcoded environment with no row here; it is a valid env_slug for env-configs only, never a deploy target.

name: fastnPlatform__listEventDeliveries
title: fastnPlatform__listEventDeliveries
description: [Fastn Workspace] List deliveries. Recent deliveries to this endpoint with status (pending, delivered, dead), attempts and the last error. Owner, admin or developer of the partner org (not a customer workspace).

name: fastnPlatform__listEventSubscriptions
title: fastnPlatform__listEventSubscriptions
description: [Fastn Workspace] List event subscriptions. The org's registered event endpoints. The signing secret is never returned here. Owner, admin or developer of the partner org (not a customer workspace).

name: fastnPlatform__listEvents
title: fastnPlatform__listEvents
description: [Fastn Workspace] List received events. Events the pipeline consumed, newest first, with the outcome each one got: dispatched (enqueued to its route bindings), no_routes (accepted but the trigger has no bindings, so delivered nowhere), dropped (the trigger was deleted or disabled between ingest and consumption), skipped_backlog (a scheduler fire not dispatched because a run it would start is already waiting for a concurrency slot; payload.skipped says which routes and why). Scoped by org_id OR end_org_id; platform_admin reads unrestricted.

type.description: One of webhook, scheduled, manual. Anything else is a 400 rather than an ignored filter.

env.description: Environment slug (test, live, or a custom one). Events have no environment of their own, so this matches events whose trigger has a route into that environment; a route with no env runs in test. An event whose trigger fans out to two environments is listed under both. A malformed slug is a 400.

search.description: Case-insensitive needle over source, connectorId, id, status and type.

limit.description: Rows per page. Default 20, max 100 — an unparameterised call still gets the 20-row page it always did.

offset.description: Zero-based row offset. Rows are ordered receivedAt DESC, id DESC so paging cannot repeat or skip rows that share a timestamp.

delivery.description: Lists the events behind a Reporting (Overview) count. dlq: dead-letter deliveries that will not be retried again (dead, or failed with every retry spent), first failed in [since, until), excluding routes to workflows labelled Internal or Staging. retrying: dead-letter deliveries still due another attempt, of any age unless since/until bound when they first failed. waiting: events received in the last hour, dispatched, with no workflow run yet (since/until are a 400 here). The Overview counts deliveries; this lists the distinct events they belong to, newest delivery first, so an event dead-lettered on two routes is one row. A delivery with no event id, or whose event is no longer kept, has no row. type, triggerId, env and search apply on top; /counts counts the same set. Anything else is a 400.

outcome.description: Lists the events behind a Reporting (Overview) events or retry number, over the Overview's window (since = window.from, until = window.to, no until when it ends now) and customer. Event numbers: received, first_attempt, recovered, not_processed, in_progress, replayed, replay_succeeded, replay_failed, replayed_from_dlq, rerun_by_hand, event_replay, after_dlq: the events the trigger_event_outcomes rows summed for that number count, by the hour each was received in, classified again when listed (an event whose outcome changed since the rollup's last pass is listed under its new one). Delivery numbers: recovered_by_retry, sent_to_dlq: the distinct events the counted deliveries carried. Every response carries countedAs { unit: events|deliveries, count (the Overview's number), unlisted (deliveries with no event to list), note }. Cannot be combined with delivery. A tenant-scoped session gets 403. Anything else is a 400.

until.description: Exclusive upper bound on receivedAt (with delivery=dlq or retrying, on when the delivery first failed). A malformed timestamp is a 400.

customer.description: Narrows to one customer, inside the caller's scope. The caller's own org id: its events with no customer on them (with delivery, the dead letters of its own triggers). An end org of the caller: events whose endOrgId is that customer (with delivery=dlq/retrying, the dead letters its triggers hold). Anything else is a 404. A token scoped to an end org may name only that end org.

name: fastnPlatform__listInstallations
title: fastnPlatform__listInstallations
description: [Fastn Workspace] List installations. Lists installations (a widget, workflow or trigger set up for one tenant) visible to the caller, newest first, each with a computed healthStatus. A tenant caller only sees its own. 403 when end_org_id is outside the caller's subtree. Requires widgets.read.

target_id.description: Filter by the bound target's id.

name: fastnPlatform__listMockStubs
title: fastnPlatform__listMockStubs
description: [Fastn Workspace] List an action's mock stubs. Lists the mock stubs (test-case responses) of a connector action, in match priority order. Requires connectors.read.

connectorId.description: Disambiguates the connector when the slug is not unique to the caller.

name: fastnPlatform__listOrgs
title: fastnPlatform__listOrgs
description: [Fastn Workspace] List tenants. Lists the caller's own org and its child orgs (owner/admin only; platform_admin sees every org). Filters narrow by type, tier and parent; include_usage adds lifetime usage counters per org.

type.description: company | partner | end_org | personal (account is accepted as an alias of company).

tier.description: account or tenant; any other value is a 400.

parent_id.description: Only children of this org. Must be the caller's own org unless platform_admin (403 otherwise).

include_usage.description: 1 or true adds executions, events, storage_gb, overage, credits, integrations and users per org.

name: fastnPlatform__listSaasConnectorConnections
title: fastnPlatform__listSaasConnectorConnections
description: [Fastn Workspace] List end customers' scoped connections for a registered SaaS connector. The customers' connections carrying a connectionScope for this connector, owned by the caller's org, newest first, with the owning customer and how many non-archived installations pin each. Unscoped connections are excluded. Paginated (default 20/page); the response carries pagination.total. Disconnect via DELETE /api/v1/connections/{id}.

name: fastnPlatform__listSaasConnectors
title: fastnPlatform__listSaasConnectors
description: [Fastn Workspace] List the org's SaaS connectors and their allowed connection scopes. Lists the connectors the caller's org designated as SaaS connectors, with their allowed connection scopes. Requires settings.read.

name: fastnPlatform__listSchedulers
title: fastnPlatform__listSchedulers
description: [Fastn Workspace] List schedulers. Lists scheduled triggers in the caller's org (or a tenant's with end_org_id), cursor-paginated. Requires events.read.

limit.description: Page size. Values above 100 are clamped to 100.

status.description: Filter by scheduler status, e.g. ACTIVE or DISABLED.

include_instances.description: true also lists triggers created by installations (per-tenant instances).

end_org_id.description: List a tenant's triggers. Must be a tenant of the caller's org, otherwise 403.

name: fastnPlatform__listSecrets
title: fastnPlatform__listSecrets
description: [Fastn Workspace] List org secrets (names only, values masked). Lists secret names and metadata (scope, type, endOrgId, environment); values are never returned. end_org_id narrows to that customer's secrets plus org-wide ones. An environment-pinned API key sees only its environment, test, and org-wide secrets.

end_org_id.description: Return this customer's secrets plus the org-wide ones.

name: fastnPlatform__listSyncJobs
title: fastnPlatform__listSyncJobs
description: [Fastn Workspace] List sync jobs. Lists the org's sync jobs, newest first (requires workflows.read).

name: fastnPlatform__listUnifiedCalls
title: fastnPlatform__listUnifiedCalls
description: [Fastn Workspace] What unified did for one of your own request ids. Single-provider calls (get, create, search, update, delete) sent with X-Fastn-Correlation-Id are recorded; this returns them for the caller's org (narrowed to the customer when the call is customer-scoped): provider, the connector service's execution id, the status the caller got, the error code when it failed, and duration. One row per real attempt, including a failure before the provider was called (e.g. 409 UNIFIED_CONNECTION_EXPIRED); replays are not recorded. Rows are kept for 30 days.

name: fastnPlatform__listUnifiedCatalogCategories
title: fastnPlatform__listUnifiedCatalogCategories
description: [Fastn Workspace] List catalog categories (admin view). Lists the platform catalog's categories with their entity counts. Requires unified.read.

name: fastnPlatform__listUnifiedCatalogEntities
title: fastnPlatform__listUnifiedCatalogEntities
description: [Fastn Workspace] List catalog entities. Lists the platform catalog's entities with their mapping counts. Requires unified.read.

name: fastnPlatform__listUnifiedCategories
title: fastnPlatform__listUnifiedCategories
description: [Fastn Workspace] List unified categories with their entities. Lists the unified API categories and their entities visible to the caller (platform catalog plus the caller's org and ancestors' custom entities, with extensions applied). Requires unified.read.

name: fastnPlatform__listUnifiedCustom
title: fastnPlatform__listUnifiedCustom
description: [Fastn Workspace] The caller's catalog orgs' own entities (with mappings) and extensions of platform entities. editable marks rows the caller's org owns.. Returns the entities owned by the caller's catalog orgs (own org and ancestors, with mappings) and the extensions of platform entities; editable marks rows the caller's org owns. Requires unified.read.

name: fastnPlatform__listUnifiedEntityProviders
title: fastnPlatform__listUnifiedEntityProviders
description: [Fastn Workspace] List mapped providers and the caller's connection state. Lists the connectors mapped for one unified entity and whether the caller has a usable connection to each. Requires unified.read; 404 for an unknown entity.

entity.description: Entity slug within the category, e.g. contacts.

endOrgId.description: The header field "x-end-org-id". Partner callers only: run the call for this customer (end-org id) and its connections. Must be a customer of the caller's org (403 otherwise); not with x-end-org-ref (400). Omitted = the caller's own scope, unchanged.

endOrgRef.description: The header field "x-end-org-ref". Partner callers only: run the call for the customer registered under this external ref. 404 when the caller has no such customer; not with x-end-org-id (400).

name: fastnPlatform__listUnifiedRecords
title: fastnPlatform__listUnifiedRecords
description: [Fastn Workspace] List canonical records; fans out over every connected provider unless ?provider= or a cursor pins one. Lists canonical records of a unified entity. Without provider, connection_id or cursor it fans out over every connected provider; a cursor is pinned to the provider that minted it and is rejected when it contradicts ?provider=. Requires unified.read.

entity.description: Entity slug within the category, e.g. contacts.

provider.description: Connector slug to pin the call to. Omitted or empty = resolve from the caller's connected providers. 400 when not a connector slug.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page.

connection_id.description: Which of the provider's connections to run against, when the org holds several accounts on the same connector. Ids come from GET /connections; one outside the caller's scope is rejected, not silently ignored.

include_remote_data.description: true adds the provider's raw record beside the canonical one.

widget_id.description: Widget whose unified config values (per connector) are applied to the call; ignored when the widget is not visible to the caller.

installationId.description: The header field "x-installation-id". Installation whose widget config values (unifiedValues) apply to this call. Omit for a call with no widget identity.

endOrgId.description: The header field "x-end-org-id". Partner callers only: run the call for this customer (end-org id) and its connections. Must be a customer of the caller's org (403 otherwise); not with x-end-org-ref (400). Omitted = the caller's own scope, unchanged.

endOrgRef.description: The header field "x-end-org-ref". Partner callers only: run the call for the customer registered under this external ref. 404 when the caller has no such customer; not with x-end-org-id (400).

name: fastnPlatform__listWebhookConfigs
title: fastnPlatform__listWebhookConfigs
description: [Fastn Workspace] List a connector's webhook configs. Webhook configs (events, subscription code, inputs, verification) of a connector. Requires connectors.read.

name: fastnPlatform__listWebhookTriggers
title: fastnPlatform__listWebhookTriggers
description: [Fastn Workspace] List webhook triggers. Lists inbound webhook triggers in the caller's org (or a tenant's with end_org_id), cursor-paginated. Requires events.read.

limit.description: Page size. Values above 100 are clamped to 100.

status.description: Filter by webhook status, e.g. ACTIVE or DISABLED.

include_instances.description: true also lists triggers created by installations (per-tenant instances).

end_org_id.description: List a tenant's triggers. Must be a tenant of the caller's org, otherwise 403.

name: fastnPlatform__listWidgets
title: fastnPlatform__listWidgets
description: [Fastn Workspace] List embed widgets. Your org's own integrations, plus, for a child org, the integrations its DIRECT parent built and offers it (never a grandparent's), marked inheritedFrom: you can run those, cannot edit them, and your own customers do not get them. A customised copy you made of one is yours (customisedFrom), and the copy and its original come back as two rows sharing version.groupId, exactly one version.active.

include.description: inherited: also return the direct parent's integrations for a platform_admin acting in a child org (every other role gets them by default)

endOrgId.description: Preview the catalog a tenant sees (its own widgets plus inherited ones, enabled and allowed for it only), as the embed would.

name: fastnPlatform__listWorkflowCategories
title: fastnPlatform__listWorkflowCategories
description: [Fastn Workspace] List workflow categories. The workspace's category registry, alphabetical. A category is ONE per workflow and decides where that workflow sits in the list — unlike a label, which is many-per-workflow and filters. Capped per workspace by plan (quota dimension workflow_categories: Launch 2, Scale 10, Enterprise 15, or an admin override); `limit` carries the cap, -1 meaning unlimited. workflowCount excludes soft-deleted workflows.

name: fastnPlatform__listWorkflowExecutions
title: fastnPlatform__listWorkflowExecutions
description: [Fastn Workspace] List executions across all workflows. Org-wide execution list, newest first. eventId/triggerId match the x-fastn-event-id / x-fastn-trigger-id headers stamped by the event pipeline on every dispatch, so a trigger fire can be correlated to its execution in one query. sort=duration lists finished runs slowest first and needs dateFrom within 30 days of dateTo (400 otherwise). List rows are metadata: they omit input, output, logs and trace (hasTrace flags a trace), and requestHeaders carries only x-fastn-event-id / x-fastn-trigger-id; outputCounts reports the run's record counts. Fetch a run's bodies from the per-execution detail route.

offset.description: Number of rows to skip for pagination (default 0).

status.description: Comma-separated statuses; matches any of them.

workflowId.description: Filter to a single workflow id (wf_*).

parentExecutionId.description: Only the sub-flow runs this execution started (fastn.flow.invoke, invokeAsync, map); each row's parentExecutionId names its parent. Still inside the caller's org scope. Present but empty matches nothing rather than every execution.

search.description: Case-insensitive match against workflow name/slug, execution id, status, triggered-by, error category, and the dispatched event and trigger ids.

searchIn.description: payload also matches search against each run's input body, e.g. a record id the sender put in a webhook, as a WHOLE value (75073605 does not match 1750736050). Ids are matched whole too, and workflow names by substring. Requires workflows.execute (403 otherwise), a search of at least 3 characters, and a dateFrom no more than 7 days before dateTo (or now); anything else is a 400. Applies to /workflows/executions/counts too.

sort.description: duration lists finished runs slowest first; it needs dateFrom within 30 days of dateTo (400 otherwise). Omitted, newest first.

name: fastnPlatform__listWorkflowLabels
title: fastnPlatform__listWorkflowLabels
description: [Fastn Workspace] List workflow labels. The workspace's label registry, alphabetical. Labels are per-workspace (org_id) with NO inheritance: a tenant never sees, renames or deletes its partner's labels. usageCount is how many LIVE workflows carry the label — soft-deleted ones are excluded, so the delete warning does not count workflows already in the trash. Capped per workspace by plan (quota dimension workflow_labels: Launch 2, Scale 10, Enterprise 15, or an admin override); `limit` carries the cap, -1 meaning unlimited.

name: fastnPlatform__listWorkflowPromotions
title: fastnPlatform__listWorkflowPromotions
description: [Fastn Workspace] List workflow promotions. The workflow's last 50 review-gated publishes and promotions (GitHub pull requests) with their status, newest first (requires workflows.read).

id.description: The workflow id (wf_*). Consumed as a path segment, not sent in the body.

name: fastnPlatform__listWorkflowStateKeys
title: fastnPlatform__listWorkflowStateKeys
description: [Fastn Workspace] List fastn.state keys. Discovery endpoint: lists existing fastn.state keys for the org so new workflows avoid key collisions.

name: fastnPlatform__listWorkflowTables
title: fastnPlatform__listWorkflowTables
description: [Fastn Workspace] List workspace DB tables. Discovery endpoint: lists tables in the org's workspace schema, or inspects one table's columns and row count when tableName is passed.

name: fastnPlatform__listWorkflowVersions
title: fastnPlatform__listWorkflowVersions
description: [Fastn Workspace] List workflow versions. The workflow's last 50 published versions, newest first, without code unless include=code (requires workflows.read). A tenant reading a parent-owned workflow never gets code.

id.description: The workflow id (wf_*). Consumed as a path segment.

name: fastnPlatform__listWorkflows
title: fastnPlatform__listWorkflows
description: [Fastn Workspace] List workflows. Lists the org's workflows (requires workflows.read). A tenant also sees the parent org's workflows that were installed for it, with code stripped. Paginated only when limit or offset is passed; the response always carries pagination.total.

deleted.description: Trash view: return ONLY soft-deleted workflows instead of live ones. Requires workflows.delete (developer and above); never cascades to the parent org. Restore one with POST /api/v1/workflows/{id}/restore.

groupBy.description: Pass `category` to order the page by category (uncategorised last) so a category's rows are contiguous and a group cannot straddle a page boundary and reappear under a second copy of its own header. Ordering only — it does not filter. The response's `categories` facet carries the per-category totals for the CURRENT filter, across every page.

label.description: Filter by label id. Repeat to narrow: labels AND together, so ?label=a&label=b returns only workflows carrying BOTH. Ids are de-duplicated. Asking for more labels than a workflow can carry (5) is unsatisfiable and returns an empty page rather than a truncated filter. Ids from another workspace match nothing.

status.description: Filter by the status the list shows: active (enabled with a published version), paused (disabled with a published version), unpublished (never published — dev_version 0, so /execute answers 409 WORKFLOW_NOT_PUBLISHED whatever enabled says). The three partition the set. An unrecognised value is ignored rather than rejected, so a stale link narrows nothing instead of failing.

updatedWithin.description: Only workflows whose updated_at falls inside this window, measured against the database clock. Relative, not an absolute dateFrom: the filter answers "what changed lately", so a shared link still answers it tomorrow. Unrecognised values are ignored.

sort.description: Order the list by a column: name (case-insensitive), status (Active, then Paused, then Not published), latest (the published dev_version, NOT the version save-counter) or updated. Applied in SQL because the list is paged - ordering the returned page would sort a page rather than a table. Omitted, the list keeps its default order (newest created first; most recently deleted first in the trash view). Unrecognised values are ignored.

dir.description: Sort direction, default desc. Only 'asc' ascends; anything else descends. Ignored without ?sort=. Rows are always tie-broken by id so OFFSET paging cannot repeat or skip a row.

executionTier.description: Only workflows of this tier. Unrecognised values are ignored.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on name, slug and description (first 200 characters).

limit.description: Page size, 1-200. Without limit or offset every workflow is returned.

name: fastnPlatform__loadUnifiedConfigFieldOptions
title: fastnPlatform__loadUnifiedConfigFieldOptions
description: [Fastn Workspace] Load select options for a widget's unified config field by executing the snippet stored on the widget (never client-supplied code); params become ctx.input for cascading selects. Runs the options snippet stored on the widget's unified config field in the workflow sandbox and returns the options, filtered by query and paged by offset/limit. An end_user may not name another tenant or installation (403).

widgetId.description: Id of the widget holding the configuration form (wgt_*).

entityId.description: Unified entity the configuration form belongs to (ue_*).

connectorSlug.description: Provider whose section of the form the field lives in, e.g. "hubspot".

fieldKey.description: Key of the select or multi-select field whose options are being loaded, e.g. "pipelineId".

params.description: Sibling field values exposed to the snippet as ctx.input — this is how a cascading select passes its parent's value, e.g. {"pipelineId": "default"}.

endOrgId.description: Tenant whose connections the snippet runs against. Rejected with 403 for end_user callers, whose own token already pins the tenant.

installationId.description: Installation whose connections the snippet runs against. Rejected with 403 for end_user callers.

limit.description: Page size, at most the server's option ceiling (UNIFIED_CONFIG_MAX_OPTIONS). Defaults to the whole result set.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring filter over label then value, applied server-side to what the snippet returned.

name: fastnPlatform__matchProductConnector
title: fastnPlatform__matchProductConnector
description: [Fastn Workspace] Find the caller's connectors for a researched product. Asks the model which connectors in the caller's own catalog call this product's API (the same product, a former name, or one of the same company's product lines), using the cached research profile for the domain when there is one. Onboarding calls it only when its host and name matching found nothing. matches is usually empty; at most 3, each with confidence high or medium and a one-sentence reason. A failed model call answers an empty list. Nothing is stored. Roles: owner, admin, developer, operator.

name: fastnPlatform__mergeProbes
title: fastnPlatform__mergeProbes
description: [Fastn Workspace] Merge sub-entity probes into a parent probe. Replaces each expanded array field of a cached parent probe with the fields of a sub-entity probe, prefixed (prefix.field). Requires connectors.read; 404 when the parent probe expired.

parentProbeId.description: The probe ID to merge into, as returned by Probe Connector Action. Must still be within its 30-minute cache window.

prefix.description: The parent field this sub-entity expands.

subProbes.description: The sub-entity probes to fold into the parent. Must contain at least one entry; unknown probe IDs are skipped.

name: fastnPlatform__probeConnector
title: fastnPlatform__probeConnector
description: [Fastn Workspace] Probe a connector action's fields. Runs a read-only connector action, infers its output fields with sample values, and caches the result for 30 minutes under the returned probeId (for field mapping). Requires connectors.read; 400 for a non-read-only action; 403 when endOrgId is not a tenant of the caller.

connectorId.description: Connector id or slug.

actionSlug.description: A read-only action: its slug must start with list, get, search, fetch, describe, find, retrieve or read.

connectionId.description: Pin the probe to a specific connection instead of the default.

endOrgId.description: Tenant whose connection to use; must descend from the caller's org.

installationId.description: Installation id, forwarded to the sandbox as x-installation-id.

name: fastnPlatform__probeConnectorValues
title: fastnPlatform__probeConnectorValues
description: [Fastn Workspace] Fetch sample values from a connector action. Runs a read-only connector action and returns its raw sample values and inferred fields, without caching. Requires connectors.read; same input rules as POST /probes.

connectorId.description: Connector id or slug.

actionSlug.description: A read-only action: its slug must start with list, get, search, fetch, describe, find, retrieve or read.

connectionId.description: Pin the probe to a specific connection instead of the default.

endOrgId.description: Tenant whose connection to use; must descend from the caller's org.

installationId.description: Installation id, forwarded to the sandbox as x-installation-id.

name: fastnPlatform__promoteWorkflow
title: fastnPlatform__promoteWorkflow
description: [Fastn Workspace] Promote a version through review. Deploys a published version to an environment, taking one of two branches depending on that environment's requiresReview flag. requiresReview false (the DEFAULT, and the state of every built-in Live environment — ensureLiveEnvironment does not set the flag): this is a bit-for-bit passthrough to /deploy. It deploys immediately, opens no PR, writes no promotion record, and — because Live is the default environment — updates the workflow's live code pointer. There is no review step despite the operation name. requiresReview true: opens a PR against the org's connected GitHub repo and records a pending promotion; the deploy runs when that PR is merged. The 200 body differs per branch (see the response schema). env_id must be a wenv_* id belonging to the caller's org, obtained from GET /api/v1/environments; a slug is not accepted. Requires workflows.deploy_prod when the target is the default (Live) environment, workflows.deploy_test otherwise.

id.description: The workflow id (wf_*). Consumed as a path segment, not sent in the body.

version_id.description: Published version to promote (wv_*). Must belong to this workflow.

message.description: Optional reviewer note; included in the PR body and commit message. Truncated server-side to 500 characters.
