name: fastnPlatform__proposeConfiguration
title: fastnPlatform__proposeConfiguration
description:
[Fastn Workspace] Enrich probes and rough field mappings into a config-review draft and return a reviewUrl. 
Propose configuration for user approval

matchingStrategy.description: Include for ongoing syncs. Add sourceProbeId/targetProbeId here to auto-augment natural keys from the probes.

name: fastnPlatform__publishWorkflow
title: fastnPlatform__publishWorkflow
description: [Fastn Workspace] Publish workflow. Publishes the workflow's draft (or current code when there is no draft) as a new immutable version and freezes its connector manifest (requires workflows.update). When the org requires review and has a GitHub repository connected, it instead opens a pull request and returns status pending_review; 409 when a publish is already awaiting review.

id.description: The workflow id (wf_*) to publish. Consumed as a path segment.

message.description: Version message; longer text is truncated.

name: fastnPlatform__refreshWorkflowManifest
title: fastnPlatform__refreshWorkflowManifest
description: [Fastn Workspace] Refresh workflow connector manifest. Re-extracts the connectors and actions the workflow's saved code calls, merges them into its connector manifest (keeping scope and connection pins) and re-resolves action ids and versions from the current catalog (requires workflows.update). Accepts the workflow id or slug.

id.description: The workflow id (wf_*) or slug whose manifest should be refreshed. Consumed as a path segment; no request body is required.

name: fastnPlatform__replayEventDelivery
title: fastnPlatform__replayEventDelivery
description: [Fastn Workspace] Replay a delivery. Sends a delivery again (same event id, marked as a redelivery), including one that was given up on. Owner, admin or developer of the partner org (not a customer workspace).

name: fastnPlatform__researchSaas
title: fastnPlatform__researchSaas
description: [Fastn Workspace] Research a SaaS company by domain. Web research on a SaaS company from its domain (e.g. hubspot.com): company profile, existing integrations, customer pain from reviews and communities, competitors, integration gaps, customer tool ecosystem, business opportunity, named customers, recent news, and the product's own API (docs, OpenAPI spec, base URL, auth, core data objects, webhook events). Returns a markdown summary, per-topic JSON (results), source URLs, and profile: a normalised product profile (company, api, entities, webhooks with use cases, existing and suggested integrations, an example first integration). progress lists four steps (website, api_docs, entities, webhooks) with status and a short finding each. Results are cached per domain for 30 days: if the domain was researched in that time, the full report comes back immediately with status "ready"; an older one, or one researched before profiles existed, is re-run. Otherwise a run starts (about 1-3 minutes; profile usually arrives first, with progress.profileReady) and the response is 202 with status "running" and id = the domain; call getSaasResearch with that domain every pollAfterSeconds until status is "ready" or "failed". refresh=true forces a new run and returns the previous report marked stale while it runs. Public email domains (gmail.com etc.) are a 400. A 402 means the org is out of AI credits; getSaasResearch still returns a cached report for the domain without spending any. Roles: owner, admin, developer, operator.

name: fastnPlatform__restoreAction
title: fastnPlatform__restoreAction
description: [Fastn Workspace] Restore a soft-deleted action. Restores a soft-deleted action from the trash. Requires connectors.delete.

name: fastnPlatform__restoreConnector
title: fastnPlatform__restoreConnector
description: [Fastn Workspace] Restore a soft-deleted connector. Restores a soft-deleted connector and its actions from the trash. Requires connectors.delete.

name: fastnPlatform__retryTriggerSubscription
title: fastnPlatform__retryTriggerSubscription
description: [Fastn Workspace] Retry upstream subscription. Re-runs the provider subscription for a FAILED/NONE app-event trigger.

name: fastnPlatform__reviseProductProfile
title: fastnPlatform__reviseProductProfile
description: [Fastn Workspace] Apply a correction to a researched product profile. Applies a person's correction, in their own words, to what research found about their product (name, description, entities, API docs URL, webhooks) and returns the corrected profile without saving it. field narrows what may change: what (name, description), core (entities), api (docs URL plus the entities and webhooks it defines), webhooks, or all. When the correction names a URL or spec, the agent reads it (web search, page fetch, OpenAPI parse) before answering, so it can take up to a minute. changed lists the fields that differ from the input; note is one sentence for the person. history carries the earlier corrections in the same panel (oldest first, at most 30, each with its outcome), so a follow-up such as "put the first one back" can be resolved; the current product already reflects what was kept. Save what they keep with the setup journey (PUT /api/v1/onboarding/setup, product). Roles: owner, admin, developer, operator.

name: fastnPlatform__rotateEventSubscriptionSecret
title: fastnPlatform__rotateEventSubscriptionSecret
description: [Fastn Workspace] Rotate a subscription's signing secret. Issues a new secret, returned once. Deliveries sent after this are signed with it. Owner, admin or developer of the partner org (not a customer workspace).

name: fastnPlatform__runWorkflowCode
title: fastnPlatform__runWorkflowCode
description: [Fastn Workspace] Test workflow code (scratch-pad). Runs the code in the request body, in the sandbox, without saving it. NOTE this does not run a stored workflow: `code` is what executes, and it is required — see POST /api/v1/workflows/{id}/test to run a saved one. `workflowId` is optional context, used to resolve the same installation (connection pins and inline config) a real dispatch of that workflow would use; it must name a workflow in the caller's org, and 404s if not, so a mistyped id is not mistaken for a successful run. When it is passed and the run succeeds with a non-empty input, that workflow's inputSchema/inputExample are re-derived from the input and testInput/testHeaders are saved as its Test-panel defaults.

code.description: Complete JavaScript module to run: export default async function(ctx) { ... }. May contain newlines/quotes; serialized safely via auto-body.

input.description: Input object exposed as ctx.input. Defaults to {} when omitted.

headers.description: Simulated request headers merged into ctx.headers. Auth/identity headers are stripped server-side.

mockMode.description: When true, every connector call is served from stored mock stubs.

partialMock.description: When true, connector calls run live where connected and mock otherwise. Ignored when mockMode is true.

mockScenarios.description: Per-action scenario overrides for mock mode, keyed by "connectorSlug.actionSlug".

timeoutMs.description: Sandbox timeout, clamped server-side between 1000 and 21600000 ms. Defaults to 120000.

workflowId.description: Optional. Runs the body's code in this workflow's installation context. Must exist in the caller's org.

verification.description: Optional. Runs contained: every connector call is mocked unless its `slug.action` is listed in liveReadActions; fastn.db statements run inside a transaction that is rolled back; fastn.state / checkpoint / envConfig writes stay in memory; fetch sends only GET/HEAD/OPTIONS and answers anything else locally; sub-flows, fastn.diff, unified writes and file uploads stop the run. The run is never saved as the workflow's test contract. The response carries a `verification` record: connectorCalls (slug, action, mode, input, ok, error), suppressed side effects, dbStatementsRolledBack, and isolationError when the run was stopped.

liveReadActions.description: `slug.action` keys the caller vouches are reads; only these reach the vendor.

name: fastnPlatform__saveOnboardingProductProfile
title: fastnPlatform__saveOnboardingProductProfile
description: [Fastn Workspace] Save the org's confirmed product profile. Replaces the default org's confirmed product profile; updatedAt and updatedBy are stamped. Roles: owner, admin, developer, platform_admin. 400 on an invalid body or when the user has no active org.

name: fastnPlatform__saveWorkflowValidation
title: fastnPlatform__saveWorkflowValidation
description: [Fastn Workspace] Save workflow validation results. Stores the result of running the workflow's test cases as its last validation, stamped with the time and caller (requires workflows.update). Each result id should be a test-case id.

id.description: The workflow id (wf_*) to attach validation results to. Consumed as a path segment.

mode.description: Whether the validation ran against mocks or live connectors.

cleanup.description: Optional note describing any cleanup performed after the run.

name: fastnPlatform__searchExecutionLogs
title: fastnPlatform__searchExecutionLogs
description: [Fastn Workspace] Search log lines across executions. The fastn.loki and mirrored console.* lines of every run the caller can see, read from Grafana Loki: the newest `limit` matches, returned oldest first. Every line's run is re-checked against the executions the caller may read, and a line whose run is not visible is dropped, so `lines` can be shorter than `limit` while `truncated` is true. With `since` (the previous answer's `cursor`) it is a live-tail poll: the newest lines from 15s before that cursor, so lines that reached Loki late are not lost; drop the ones already shown. `since` is clamped inside the dateFrom/dateTo window, so it can never widen the search, and one past dateTo answers no lines. `cursor` is the newest line Loki answered (visible or not), never behind `since`, and with no lines the end of the window on the server's clock. The run-end line each run writes (`source: fastn.run`, Loki label `status`) is not returned. Lines are kept for Loki's retention (14 days on the run-logs instance), not the run's. Requires workflows.execute to see lines: other roles get 200 with `available: false, reason: redacted`. Loki unset or failing is 200 with `available: false` and a reason.

q.description: Case-insensitive text matched literally against the whole line, message and logged data alike.

dateFrom.description: Default: one hour before dateTo. At most 7 days before dateTo.

since.description: Live tail: the previous answer's cursor (nanoseconds). Clamped to the window.

name: fastnPlatform__searchUnifiedRecords
title: fastnPlatform__searchUnifiedRecords
description: [Fastn Workspace] Search records by filters via one provider. Only for entities whose mapping offers search (discovery lists the accepted names in searchFilters). The body is the filters, e.g. {"phone": "+15550100"} or {"query": "jane@x.com", "time_min": "2026-10-16T00:00:00Z"}. Returns the first page of matches.

entity.description: Entity slug within the category, e.g. contacts.

provider.description: Connector slug to pin the call to. Omitted or empty = resolve from the caller's connected providers. 400 when not a connector slug.

connection_id.description: Which of the provider's connections to run against, when the org holds several accounts on the same connector. Ids come from GET /connections; one outside the caller's scope is rejected, not silently ignored.

fastnCorrelationId.description: The header field "X-Fastn-Correlation-Id". Your own id for this request (a call, a job). Echoed back, and the call is recorded under it: GET /api/v1/unified/calls?correlation_id=...

installationId.description: The header field "x-installation-id". Installation whose widget config values (unifiedValues) apply to this call. Omit for a call with no widget identity.

endOrgId.description: The header field "x-end-org-id". Partner callers only: run the call for this customer (end-org id) and its connections. Must be a customer of the caller's org (403 otherwise); not with x-end-org-ref (400). Omitted = the caller's own scope, unchanged.

endOrgRef.description: The header field "x-end-org-ref". Partner callers only: run the call for the customer registered under this external ref. 404 when the caller has no such customer; not with x-end-org-id (400).

name: fastnPlatform__searchWeb
title: fastnPlatform__searchWeb
description: [Fastn Workspace] Search the web. Web search through the platform's search providers. platform, when given, is prefixed to the query. Requires connectors.read; 502 when every provider fails.

query.description: The search query. Required; an empty query is rejected with 400.

platform.description: Product name to scope the search, e.g. HubSpot.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return. Clamped to 1-20; defaults to 5.

name: fastnPlatform__sendTestAppEvent
title: fastnPlatform__sendTestAppEvent
description: [Fastn Workspace] Send an app event to a connector's ingest URL. The ingest URL of a connector's app registration, which the provider posts events to; posting a synthetic event here fires the matching app-event triggers end to end. The registration's verification applies: a connector whose method needs a signature rejects an unsigned request with 401. The event type and account id are read from the body with the registration's extractors. triggerId restricts delivery to one trigger. Not authenticated by fastn credentials.

orgId.description: The org that owns the registration (org_platform for the shared catalog).

connectorId.description: Connector UUID the trigger listens on (path)

triggerId.description: Deliver only to this app-event trigger.

payload.description: The event payload, shaped as the provider sends it. An array is processed as one event per element.

name: fastnPlatform__setDefaultConnection
title: fastnPlatform__setDefaultConnection
description: [Fastn Workspace] Make a connection the default. Makes this connection the default for its connector, unsetting the previous default. Reads and writes Postgres only, so a UCL-held connection is not found (404); use updateConnection with isDefault: true for those. Requires connections.update.

id.description: Connection id (a ucl: id for a UCL-held connection).

name: fastnPlatform__setEnvironmentReviewRequirement
title: fastnPlatform__setEnvironmentReviewRequirement
description: [Fastn Workspace] Toggle review gating for an environment. Sets requiresReview. When true, /workflows/{id}/deploy refuses the environment with a 409 and the caller must use /workflows/{id}/promote, which opens a real PR against the org's connected GitHub repo.

requiresReview.description: True to force promotion through a pull request; false to allow direct deploys. Required boolean.

name: fastnPlatform__setGithubPublishGate
title: fastnPlatform__setGithubPublishGate
description: [Fastn Workspace] Choose the repo or toggle the publish gate. Sets the repository workflows sync to (repoOwner + repoName, which must be shared with the GitHub App) and/or gatePublish (publishing a workflow opens a pull request for review). 409 when a repo change would strand a pending sync or review. Requires settings.update.

gatePublish.description: True to require a merged pull request before a publish creates a version; false to publish immediately. Required boolean.

name: fastnPlatform__setTriggerReporting
title: fastnPlatform__setTriggerReporting
description: [Fastn Workspace] Choose which events Reporting counts. Count only the events whose payload is an object with this top-level key, so a provider's health checks posted to the same webhook stay out of the event figures. Reporting only: the trigger still accepts and routes every event. Null counts every event. A change recounts the trigger's held history: the last day within half an hour, older days over the following hours.

name: fastnPlatform__setTriggerStatus
title: fastnPlatform__setTriggerStatus
description: [Fastn Workspace] Pause or resume a trigger. Pauses (DISABLED) or resumes (ACTIVE) any trigger by id, whatever its type. Pausing a scheduler also unregisters its timer; resuming registers it again. Requires events.update; 404 when the trigger is not in the caller's org.

name: fastnPlatform__setWidgetActiveVersion
title: fastnPlatform__setWidgetActiveVersion
description: [Fastn Workspace] Choose which version of a customised integration your org runs. {id} is the ORIGINAL widget. activeWidgetId is either the original itself or your org's live fork of it. In the customer catalog (GET /widgets as an end user) the pair is returned as two rows sharing version.groupId, exactly one with version.active = true. Exactly one version runs: switching pauses the customer's active setups on the version it leaves, resumes the ones an earlier switch paused on the version it returns to, and where that version has no setup yet recreates the paused ones on it with the same connections, label and answers (data.carried). A setup cannot be created or resumed on the inactive version (409 VERSION_INACTIVE). Ask the customer before switching. Accepts ?endOrgId= for a partner previewing a tenant.

endOrgId.description: Partner preview: act for this tenant as its embed would

activeWidgetId.description: The original itself, or your org's copy of it

name: fastnPlatform__setWorkflowConnectorScope
title: fastnPlatform__setWorkflowConnectorScope
description: [Fastn Workspace] Patch one connector manifest entry. Tunes ONE connector entry: tenancy scope + connection pin, the connector-level retry/timeout override, and per-action overrides. The surgical counterpart to PUT /workflows/{id}, which replaces the whole manifest array and so requires the caller to read and echo back every other entry. Applied as a partial at the FIELD level: an omitted field is left untouched, an explicit null clears that override so the entry inherits the connector row again, and at least one settable field must be present. A retryPolicy that is sent REPLACES the stored override rather than merging into it — merging would leave no way to remove a field from a stored layer. Identity fields (slug, connectorId, orgId, action id/version) are not settable — the code extractor owns them, and repointing one here would desync the manifest from the code it describes.

slug.description: The manifest connector slug OR the connectorId — slug matched first, connectorId second. Matched against this workflow's manifest only, not the connector catalog.

scope.description: Optional. SAAS uses the developer's own connection and may pin one; MULTI_TENANT resolves a connection per tenant and clears any pin. Omit to leave the scope as it is. Any other value is rejected with 400.

connectionId.description: The connection to pin. Applied when scope is SAAS; ignored and cleared to null when scope is MULTI_TENANT. Sent without a scope it requires the entry to already be SAAS, otherwise 400.

retryPolicy.description: This workflow's retry override for EVERY action on this connector, layered over the connector row's own values. Partial - unset fields inherit. Send null to clear the override. This is the retry policy for the connector CALLS the workflow makes, not the workflow-run retry policy on createWorkflow/updateWorkflow.

timeoutMs.description: Per-request wall-clock for every action on this connector in this workflow. 1000-3600000. Send null to clear the override.

actions.description: The highest-priority retry/timeout layer, for one action only. Every slug must already exist on the manifest entry - action entries are written by the code extractor at save time, so an unknown slug returns 404 with knownActionSlugs.

name: fastnPlatform__setWorkflowLabels
title: fastnPlatform__setWorkflowLabels
description: [Fastn Workspace] Set a workflow's labels. Replaces the workflow's labels wholesale — send the full set, not a delta. Ids are de-duplicated BEFORE the cap is applied, so ["l1","l1"] is one label and is accepted. More than 5 distinct ids is refused with code WF-LABEL-LIMIT and no write. Every id must belong to the caller's workspace. The whole operation runs in one transaction behind a row lock on the workflow, so concurrent calls cannot interleave past the cap.

name: fastnPlatform__startGithubInstallation
title: fastnPlatform__startGithubInstallation
description: [Fastn Workspace] Start the GitHub App install. Returns the GitHub URL that installs the fastn GitHub App for this org; GitHub redirects back to the callback. 503 when the deployment has no GitHub App configured. Requires settings.update.

returnUrl.description: Where to send the user after GitHub redirects back. Optional.

dashboardOrigin.description: Origin used to build the return redirect. Optional; inferred from the request when omitted.

name: fastnPlatform__storeConnections
title: fastnPlatform__storeConnections
description: [Fastn Workspace] Store connector credentials. Creates (or upserts) a connection. Partner backends select the customer org either via the identity headers (x-org-id + x-user-id, proven with x-identity-hmac when the API key's identity-verification mode requires it) or via orgId/endOrgId in the body (tenant's fastn org id or its external_ref). When identity headers are present, body orgId/userId must agree with the claim. Upserts by name, or by scope when `connectionScope` is set (re-provisioning a scope rotates that row's credentials); `connectionScope` requires a tenant (endOrgId) and must be one of the connector's allowed scopes in the org's SaaS-connector registry.

connectorId.description: Connector this connection belongs to

authMethodId.description: Auth method id used by the connection

authType.description: Optional; derived from authMethodId if omitted

expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the stored credentials expire.

userId.description: External ref for personal connections; omit for org-wide

userEmail.description: Display-only email of the connecting user.

userName.description: Display-only name of the connecting user.

endOrgId.description: Admin preview: create under this tenant

name: fastnPlatform__syncWorkflowsToGithub
title: fastnPlatform__syncWorkflowsToGithub
description: [Fastn Workspace] Mirror workflows to GitHub. Opens a pull request mirroring every publishable workflow into the connected repository. Returns up_to_date when nothing changed. 409 with the blocking PR when a sync is already awaiting review. Requires workflows.update.

name: fastnPlatform__testEventSubscription
title: fastnPlatform__testEventSubscription
description: [Fastn Workspace] Send a test event. Queues one signed endpoint.test event to the endpoint. Owner, admin or developer of the partner org (not a customer workspace).

name: fastnPlatform__testSavedWorkflow
title: fastnPlatform__testSavedWorkflow
description: [Fastn Workspace] Test saved workflow. Runs a saved workflow synchronously in the sandbox. No execution row is recorded, so the run does not appear in execution history. It is still a run: it counts toward the monthly run quota (executions_per_month) and takes one of the org's instant concurrency slots, and is refused with 429 exactly as POST /{id}/execute is when either is spent. Skipping the history is the ONLY thing it avoids: the workflow's real code runs against real connections, so every side effect is real — fastn.db writes land in your workspace, connector actions hit the live provider, and records are genuinely created. mockMode:true narrows this but does NOT remove it: it routes fastn.connector.* calls to stored stubs, so the provider is not touched. fastn.db writes are unaffected and still land in your workspace — the sandbox db context never sees the flag. On success the tested input becomes the workflow's contract: inputSchema/inputExample are re-derived from a non-empty input, and the input/headers are saved as its testInput/testHeaders defaults.

id.description: The workflow id (wf_*) or slug to test. Consumed as a path segment.

input.description: Input object exposed to the workflow as ctx.input. Defaults to {} when omitted.

headers.description: Simulated request headers merged into ctx.headers. Auth/identity headers (x-jwt-*, x-gateway-token) are stripped server-side.

mockMode.description: When true, every fastn.connector.* call is served from stored mock stubs instead of live APIs.

partialMock.description: When true, connector calls run live where a connection exists and fall back to mocks otherwise. Ignored when mockMode is true.

mockScenarios.description: Per-action scenario overrides for mock mode. Key is "connectorSlug.actionSlug", value is a scenario-name substring.

name: fastnPlatform__testUnifiedCustomEntity
title: fastnPlatform__testUnifiedCustomEntity
description: [Fastn Workspace] Test-execute an entity the caller can see (own, ancestor's, or platform with the caller's extensions) against the caller's own connections (unified.customize). Runs list, get or create for an entity the caller can see against the caller's own connections. Requires unified.customize. 404 when the entity is not visible or has no enabled mappings.

name: fastnPlatform__triggerSchedulerNow
title: fastnPlatform__triggerSchedulerNow
description: [Fastn Workspace] Fire scheduler now. Run-now: dispatches the scheduler's routes immediately. The returned eventId lands in the resulting execution's request headers (x-fastn-event-id), closing the trigger-to-execution verification loop.

name: fastnPlatform__updateAction
title: fastnPlatform__updateAction
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update an action. Updates an action of a connector the caller's org owns. The contract linter may refuse a bodyTemplate that does not match the inputContract (400). Requires connectors.update.

id.description: ID of the action to update (path parameter).

authMethodId.description: Override the connector's default auth method for this action (nullable).

httpConfig.description: Full replacement HTTP config. Include all fields to keep; null deletes a key.

stage.description: Promote to live or revert to test.

name: fastnPlatform__updateAlert
title: fastnPlatform__updateAlert
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update alert rule. Partial update: omit a field to leave it unchanged. Cross-field rules apply to the rule's final state: a code rule cannot carry workflowIds, and a rule that is (or becomes) a threshold rule stores throttle=true.

endOrgId.description: Act on this tenant's own alert rules ("view as tenant"). Alerts are not inherited: each org has its own.

name: fastnPlatform__updateAppEventTrigger
title: fastnPlatform__updateAppEventTrigger
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update an app-event trigger. Partially updates an app-event trigger. routes and events, when sent, replace the whole list. Requires events.update.

id.description: Identifier of the app event trigger to update.

name.description: New display name for the trigger (1-200 characters).

status.description: Whether the trigger is subscribed and dispatching events.

events.description: Connector events the trigger subscribes to. Replaces the existing list.

routes.description: Route bindings that receive the event. Replaces the existing bindings.

additionalConfig.description: Extra trigger settings stored alongside the app trigger.

accountId.description: Connected account the trigger listens on. Send null to clear it.

name: fastnPlatform__updateAuthMethod
title: fastnPlatform__updateAuthMethod
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update an auth method. Updates an auth method of a connector the caller's org owns. Requires connectors.update.

id.description: ID of the auth method to update (path parameter).

isDefault.description: Set as the default auth method.

docsUrl.description: Link shown on the connect page above the credential fields ('Where do I find these?'). Set it per auth method so the link points at the docs for the credential actually being requested. Null clears it.

name: fastnPlatform__updateAuthProvider
title: fastnPlatform__updateAuthProvider
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update an auth provider. Updates an OAuth app. A shared-catalog provider can only be changed by platform_admin. Requires connectors.update.

id.description: ID of the OAuth provider to update (path parameter).

clientSecret.description: Updated OAuth client secret (encrypted at rest).

name: fastnPlatform__updateConfig
title: fastnPlatform__updateConfig
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update a config. Replaces the fields sent. Send baseUpdatedAt (the updatedAt you loaded) to get 409 CONFIG_CONFLICT instead of overwriting a newer save. To edit one row of an array-typed configuration prefer the /entries endpoints. Requires widgets.update.

config.description: Replacement config payload (field mappings, conditions, defaults, matching strategy).

name: fastnPlatform__updateConfigDecisions
title: fastnPlatform__updateConfigDecisions
description: [Fastn Workspace] Set configuration decisions. Sets the value of named decision fields (connector-declared defaults or AI-proposed configurationDecisions) and/or merges keys into matching. 400 DECISION_FIELDS_NOT_FOUND when no named field exists; a partial match answers 200 with the misses in unmatched. Requires widgets.update.

decisions.description: Field default decisions. Each entry updates the matching field's default value across every entity in the config. Supply this and/or matching.

matching.description: Keys merged over the config's matching strategy.

name: fastnPlatform__updateConnection
title: fastnPlatform__updateConnection
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update a connection. Renames a connection, reconnects it with new credentials, or makes it the connector's default (isDefault: true). For a UCL-held connection only those three are supported (400 otherwise). 409 when the new name is already used at the same address. Requires connections.create.

id.description: ID of the connection to update (path parameter).

name.description: New connection name. Must stay unique for this connector within the tenant, or the request returns 409.

credentials.description: Replacement credential key/value pairs, vault-encrypted on write. Supplying this re-runs credential verification.

authType.description: New authentication scheme for the connection.

expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the stored credentials expire. Null clears it.

name: fastnPlatform__updateConnector
title: fastnPlatform__updateConnector
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update connector. Updates a connector the caller's org owns. Changing visibility to public is platform_admin only. Requires connectors.update.

id.description: ID of the connector to update (path parameter).

icon.description: Updated icon URL or SVG. Max 500 chars.

authMethods.description: Auth methods to add or update. Include id to update existing, omit id to add new.

category.description: Browse category key shown in the catalog, e.g. crm-sales, developer-tools, ai-ml, communication, productivity, project-management, finance-payments, analytics-monitoring, marketing, data-database, ecommerce, search-web, social-media, cloud-devops, design, it-service, docs-knowledge, entertainment-media, maps-location, other. Sets categoryKey; the connector tier (managed/Custom) never changes. Null clears it.

connectionVerifyActionId.description: Id of the action executed at connect time to prove the submitted credentials work. Must be an action belonging to this connector, read-only (GET or HEAD), and with no required inputs - nothing supplies them at connect time. Null clears the verifier.

verifySuccessPath.description: Optional dotted path that must resolve in the verification response, for example '$.id'. Use it when the provider answers bad credentials with a 2xx instead of a 401 - a 2xx that does not contain this path is treated as 'invalid'. Null clears it.

name: fastnPlatform__updateEventSubscription
title: fastnPlatform__updateEventSubscription
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update an event subscription. Change the URL, event types, filters, payload template (null clears it), description, or pause it (enabled: false; events queue and are sent when it is enabled again, within 24 hours). Owner, admin or developer of the partner org (not a customer workspace).

eventTypes.description: Event types to send. Empty or omitted: every account and setup-link event (connection.*, setup_link.*). connector.event, unified.event and workflow.event are sent only when listed.

connectorCategories.description: connector.event, unified.event and workflow.event: send events from connectors in these catalog categories (e.g. project-management). An event matches when its connector is in connectors OR its connector's category is here. Both empty or omitted: every connector.

workflowEvents.description: workflow.event only: send only events workflow code emits under these names (fastn.events.emit("ticket.created", ...)). Empty or omitted: every name. The connectors filter applies too, matched against the connector the code named.

payloadTemplate.description: workflow.event only: send the body in the endpoint's own schema. { connectors?: { <connector slug or id>: schema }, default?: schema }, where schema is a JSON Schema object: { type: "object", properties: { <field>: { type?, "x-source"?: <dotted path into the event, e.g. payload.finding.id>, const?, default?, properties? } }, required?: [<field>] }. The event's connector picks the schema, else default. type (string, number, integer, boolean, object, array) converts what it can; an empty optional field is left out; an event that cannot fill a required field is not sent and its delivery records why. With no schema (or null) the standard body is sent. Headers are unchanged; the signature covers the body actually sent.

name: fastnPlatform__updateInstallation
title: fastnPlatform__updateInstallation
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update an installation. Updates an installation. Changing selected_trigger_categories provisions newly covered trigger instances and deletes uncovered ones. 400 when nothing applicable was sent or a referenced widget, config or connection is not the caller's; 409 on a duplicate label for the widget. Requires workflows.update.

id.description: The installation id (inst_*) to update. Consumed as a path segment.

widget_id.description: New widget id (must belong to the org) (nullable).

connections.description: Replacement connection pin map; each connection must belong to the org or be platform-wide.

status.description: New status; transitions to/from 'active' fire lifecycle hooks.

name: fastnPlatform__updateInstallationUnifiedValues
title: fastnPlatform__updateInstallationUnifiedValues
description: [Fastn Workspace] Merge per-customer unified config values into an installation's inline config (end_user-callable; scoped by org_id or end_org_id). Writes per-connector unified-API field values into the installation's inline config (connectorSlug -> fieldKey -> value). Requires unified.execute.

unifiedValues.description: Configuration values keyed by connector slug, then by field key — for example {"hubspot": {"pipelineId": "default"}}. The legacy nested shape keyed by entity id first is also accepted.

name: fastnPlatform__updateOrgConfig
title: fastnPlatform__updateOrgConfig
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update org config document. Merges the body into org_configs.config at the top level. `orgName` is not a config key: it is written through to the org's `name` column (readable at GET /api/v1/orgs/{id}) and never stored in the document. Accepted at the top level or nested under `config`, and must be a non-blank string of at most 200 characters with no control characters, angle brackets or invisible characters. A value that differs from the current name is a rename and requires org.update; resending the name the org already has is a no-op and needs only settings.update, so a form that posts the name on every save still works. Omit it to leave the name unchanged; a blank value is rejected rather than clearing the saved name. The rename and the config write commit together. Only some keys may be changed, by who is writing: on its own org, timezone, setupLinkRedirectUrls and setupLinkDefaultTtlMinutes; an account on its own org also customer_tiers; a partner on one of its customers also tier, limits and roleOverride; a platform admin anything. A key outside that set is refused with 403 CONFIG_KEY_NOT_ALLOWED (a key sent with its stored value is ignored). roleOverride and a tier roleId cannot name an account-level role.

orgName.description: Renames the org. Written to orgs.name, not to the config document.

name: fastnPlatform__updateScheduler
title: fastnPlatform__updateScheduler
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update a scheduler. Partially updates a scheduler and re-registers its timer. cron and rate cannot both be sent. routes, when sent, replaces the whole binding list. Requires events.update.

id.description: Identifier of the scheduler trigger to update.

name.description: New display name for the scheduler (1-200 characters).

status.description: Whether the scheduler is registered and firing.

cron.description: Standard five-field cron schedule. Cannot be combined with rate.

rate.description: Fire at a fixed interval. Cannot be combined with cron.

delayMinutes.description: Delay in minutes applied after each scheduled time.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the schedule is evaluated in, for example 'Europe/Berlin'.

startsAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp before which the scheduler does not fire.

additionalConfig.description: Extra scheduler settings stored alongside the trigger.

routes.description: Route bindings the scheduler fires into. Replaces the existing bindings.

reenableAfterMinutes.description: Minutes after an automatic disable before the scheduler is re-enabled (1-1440).

name: fastnPlatform__updateSecret
title: fastnPlatform__updateSecret
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update a secret value. type omitted keeps the stored type, which still decides whether the new value must parse as JSON.

id.description: The secret's name (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE), not its generated id.

end_org_id.description: Customer (tenant) scope of the secret; omitted means the org-wide secret.

environment.description: Environment scope of the secret; omitted means no environment narrowing.

name: fastnPlatform__updateSetupJourney
title: fastnPlatform__updateSetupJourney
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update the setup journey state. Merges the given fields into the org's setup journey; completedAt is stamped when status leaves in_progress and cleared when it returns. Send only what changed: an AI tool needs status, step and the step's own fields (product, useCase, connectorIds, widgetId). screen is the dashboard's and should be left out; a write that changes step without it clears it, so the dashboard resumes at the first step its records show open. Roles: owner, admin, developer, platform_admin. 400 when the user has no active org.

step.description: 1 = connect your product, 2 = choose integrations, 3 = embed the widget, 4 = customers connect.

screen.description: Set by the dashboard: the onboarding path it last showed, for resuming. AI tools leave it out.

product.description: Step 1 product profile. Sent whole; the merge is shallow.

direction.description: access: database access or SFTP rather than an API

name: fastnPlatform__updateTenant
title: fastnPlatform__updateTenant
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update tenant. Updates an org the caller may manage. plan is platform_admin only; status may be changed by platform_admin, or by an owner/admin on its own child org. external_ref is immutable: resending the stored value is a no-op, any other value is a 400.

id.description: The customer: fastn's org id, or the id you gave the customer at creation (orgId / externalRef).

name: fastnPlatform__updateUnifiedCustomEntity
title: fastnPlatform__updateUnifiedCustomEntity
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update one of the caller org's entities (unified.customize). Updates an entity the caller's org owns. Requires unified.customize. 400 when no field is given; 404 when not found.

name: fastnPlatform__updateUnifiedCustomMapping
title: fastnPlatform__updateUnifiedCustomMapping
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update a mapping on one of the caller org's entities (unified.customize). Updates a mapping on an entity the caller's org owns. Requires unified.customize. 404 when not found.

name: fastnPlatform__updateUnifiedRecord
title: fastnPlatform__updateUnifiedRecord
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update a record (partial canonical body) via one provider. Only for entities whose mapping offers update. Sends only the fields named; unsent fields keep their value.

entity.description: Entity slug within the category, e.g. contacts.

provider.description: Connector slug to pin the call to. Omitted or empty = resolve from the caller's connected providers. 400 when not a connector slug.

connection_id.description: Which of the provider's connections to run against, when the org holds several accounts on the same connector. Ids come from GET /connections; one outside the caller's scope is rejected, not silently ignored.

idempotencyKey.description: The header field "Idempotency-Key". Makes a retry safe: the same key on this route for the same org and customer answers from the first run for 24 hours (Idempotent-Replayed: true) instead of calling the provider again. A key still in flight is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS; the same key sent with a different query string or body is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

fastnCorrelationId.description: The header field "X-Fastn-Correlation-Id". Your own id for this request (a call, a job). Echoed back, and the call is recorded under it: GET /api/v1/unified/calls?correlation_id=...

installationId.description: The header field "x-installation-id". Installation whose widget config values (unifiedValues) apply to this call. Omit for a call with no widget identity.

endOrgId.description: The header field "x-end-org-id". Partner callers only: run the call for this customer (end-org id) and its connections. Must be a customer of the caller's org (403 otherwise); not with x-end-org-ref (400). Omitted = the caller's own scope, unchanged.

endOrgRef.description: The header field "x-end-org-ref". Partner callers only: run the call for the customer registered under this external ref. 404 when the caller has no such customer; not with x-end-org-id (400).

name: fastnPlatform__updateWebhookConfig
title: fastnPlatform__updateWebhookConfig
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update a webhook config. Requires connectors.update.

id.description: ID of the webhook config to update (path parameter).

name: fastnPlatform__updateWebhookTrigger
title: fastnPlatform__updateWebhookTrigger
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update a webhook trigger. Partially updates a webhook trigger. routes, when sent, replaces the whole binding list. Requires events.update.

id.description: Identifier of the webhook trigger to update.

name.description: New display name for the webhook trigger (1-200 characters).

status.description: Whether the trigger accepts incoming events.

authMethod.description: How callers of the public webhook URL are authenticated.

routeExecutionMode.description: Whether bound routes run in parallel or one after another.

additionalConfig.description: Extra trigger settings, such as uniquePayloadFieldPath for deduplication.

routes.description: Route bindings that receive the event. Replaces the existing bindings.

name: fastnPlatform__updateWidget
title: fastnPlatform__updateWidget
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update widget. Shrinking trigger_categories while trigger_refs still tag a removed slug is rejected (400). connector_refs[].connectionScope (SaaS-connector activation pinning) is validated against the org's saas_connectors registry.. Partial update; omitted fields keep their stored value, and an omitted unified_refs[].configForm keeps the stored form. Allowed when the caller is owner/admin/developer in the widget's owning workspace; 403 WIDGET_NOT_IN_ACCOUNT otherwise (an inherited widget must be forked first).

connectionScope.description: SaaS-connector connection scope: activation pins the tenant's connection with this scope (400 when the tenant has none) and the customer connect flow hides this connector. Must be in the org's saas_connectors registry for this connector. Not the OAuth scopes.

trigger_categories_title.description: Heading for the activation wizard's sync-type selection step; null uses the built-in 'What do you want to sync?'.

name: fastnPlatform__updateWorkflow
title: fastnPlatform__updateWorkflow
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update workflow. Partial update of a workflow (requires workflows.update): only the fields sent are changed. `documentation` is rejected with 400; send documentationOverride to edit the partner-facing doc. A body carrying `code` is refused with 403 WF-CODE-READONLY when the org may read but not write workflow code. Changing only enabled, categoryId or documentationOverride does not bump the version.

categoryId.description: Category ID from listWorkflowCategories; null = Uncategorised. One category per workflow. A categoryId of null read from an inherited (partner) workflow means unknown, never copy it to another workflow.

inputSchema.description: REQUIRED. JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for ctx.input. Re-derive from an example when the input shape changes; otherwise pass the workflow's existing schema unchanged.

enabled.description: Set true to enable the workflow.

testCases.description: REQUIRED. The user-approved test cases covering the workflow's logic, with executable fixtures (input/headers/mockScenarios). Pass the current set from getWorkflow when unchanged; extend it when the update adds logic.

testInput.description: REQUIRED. JSON text saved as the Test panel's ctx.input default (max 64KB). Pass the current value from getWorkflow when unchanged; "{}" when the workflow takes no input.

testHeaders.description: REQUIRED. JSON text saved as the Test panel's ctx.headers default (max 64KB). Pass the current value from getWorkflow when unchanged; "{}" when no headers are needed.

name: fastnPlatform__updateWorkflowCategory
title: fastnPlatform__updateWorkflowCategory
description: [Fastn Workspace] Update workflow category. Rename or recolour. At least one of name/colour is required.

colour.description: Palette token name, one of: chart-1, chart-2, chart-3, brand, success, info, warning, danger

name: fastnPlatform__upsertEnvironmentConfig
title: fastnPlatform__upsertEnvironmentConfig
description: [Fastn Workspace] Upsert environment config. Sets the key's value for each environment slug in values, creating the key if needed; environments not named keep their value (requires workflows.update).

key.description: The config key (max 256 chars). Consumed as a path segment.

values.description: env_slug -> value (any JSON). 'test' and 'live' are built in; any other slug must be an environment of this org (400 otherwise).

name: fastnPlatform__upsertSaasConnector
title: fastnPlatform__upsertSaasConnector
description: [Fastn Workspace] Designate a connector as a SaaS connector and set its allowed connection scopes. Admin/owner only (settings.update). connectorId may be the connector's id or its slug; the registration always stores the id. Scopes validate tenant connection creation and drive the widget editor's connection-scope picker.

name: fastnPlatform__upsertUnifiedExtension
title: fastnPlatform__upsertUnifiedExtension
description: [Fastn Workspace] Create or replace the caller org's extension of a platform entity: extra canonical fields plus, per mapped connector, field mappings and staticInput values to append (e.g. HubSpot properties). Visible to the org and its tenants only (unified.customize).. Creates or replaces the caller org's extension of a platform entity. Requires unified.customize. 404 when the platform entity does not exist; 400 when the extension conflicts with the entity.

name: fastnPlatform__whoami
title: fastnPlatform__whoami
description: [Fastn Workspace] Get the caller's resolved identity. Who you are talking to. Answers from the gateway's resolved context, so it works for every credential a caller can arrive with — a dashboard JWT, an API key, an embed (widget) token and a share link alike; unlike GET /api/v1/profile, which reads the Keycloak user and is therefore unavailable to an embed session. Call it before your first substantive reply and adapt to the answer. Two independent axes, and do not collapse them: `actor` is WHICH CREDENTIAL, `actingAsTenant` is WHOSE WORKSPACE. `actingAsTenant: true` means the credential was minted for a tenant of a parent org — `org` is that customer's own workspace and `parentOrg` is the partner whose product they are using — so speak in business terms about their own connections and not about building the platform. Their provider's integrations are theirs to use, and to customise by forking a copy into their own workspace (forkIntegration) - never in place. It is true for a partner's customer in an embedded widget AND for a tenant-scoped API key, so it does not on its own mean a human is present; read `actor` for that. `actingAsTenant: false` means the caller is acting as the org itself, which for `actor: user` is the partner's own staff in the dashboard, with `role` naming the persona. `permissions` reports three layers rather than one merged list, because enforcement is a layered predicate and a merged copy would drift from it: `role` is the enforced baseline for the persona, `structured` narrows it when present (an action needs both; it is reported already intersected with the role, so it is the effective set), and `apiKeyGrant` is a ceiling over both and never widens them. Retired-resource entries may appear in `role` and govern nothing. Every tool call you make executes under this identity, so a 403 means this persona lacks the permission rather than a fault worth retrying. One limitation: a caller whose token carries no org claim at all is answered 401 rather than a partial identity, which in practice means a platform_admin holding no org_id — the same guard every other /api/v1/me/* read uses.

name: fastnPlatform__trillet_callback
title: fastnPlatform__trillet_callback
description: [Fastn Workspace] Widget lifecycle hook target. Sends a signed event (connection.connected / disconnected / revoked) to Trillet's callback URL with 3 tries and keeps an outbox record; failed events are queued for trillet-redeliver. Secrets: TRILLET_CALLBACK_URL, TRILLET_CALLBACK_SECRET.

name: fastnPlatform__trillet_expiry_check
title: fastnPlatform__trillet_expiry_check

name: fastnPlatform__trillet_google_calendar

name: fastnPlatform__trillet_hubspot
title: fastnPlatform__trillet_hubspot

title: fastnPlatform__trillet_link

Default: setup link for one app, 7 days, business created on first use. addAccount true: 10-minute sign-in link that adds another account to an existing business. embed true: 8-hour token and iframe URL to show the widgets inside Trillet's own app.

title: fastnPlatform__trillet_redeliver

name: skill
title: Workspace skills
description:
Browses, reads, and inspects this workspace's SKILLS - named playbooks/composites that bundle a task into one governed action; a saved skill may already cover a task no loaded tool fits. Read-only. Parameter presence picks the action:
- {} -> LIST all skills (lean routing view: slug, name, description, version, mode, downloadUrl; add {"withScore":true} for the authoring view with quality scores).
- {"slug":"x"} -> LOAD that skill's full SKILL.md to READ it. Never executes. Also returns its reference-doc map and a ~15-min installable Agent-Skill zip downloadUrl.
- {"slug":"x","ref":"<doc>"} -> open ONE named reference document on demand (progressive disclosure - never pre-load them all).
- {"slug":"x","history":true} -> the full change history (every version, who/when/note).
- {"slug":"x","knownVersion":N[,"toVersion":M]} -> per-file version DIFF (SKILL.md + each reference doc as changed/added/removed) so you know what to re-fetch.
- {"slugs":["a","b"]} -> cheap existence/version probe for JUST those slugs.
To RUN a skill, call its slug as a tool (or run_tool {"name":"<slug>"} when it is not in your tool list); reading here never runs anything.

slug.description: A skill slug: alone = load its SKILL.md; with ref/history/knownVersion = that view.

ref.description: With slug: open this named reference document (from the skill's reference map).

history.description: With slug: return the skill's full change history instead of the body.

knownVersion.description: With slug: the version you already have - returns a per-file diff to the target.

toVersion.description: With slug + knownVersion: the version to diff TO (default: latest).

slugs.description: Existence probe: return ONLY these slugs as slim {slug,name,version,exists}.

withScore.description: List view: include quality scores + stale referenced tools (authoring).

name: feedback
title: Send feedback
description: Files feedback for review. Use it when (1) the user explicitly corrects you, points out a mistake or asks you to report something (source "human", their words verbatim in `correction`), or (2) a tool or connection returns an error while doing what the user asked (kind "error"). Not for routine results; once per issue (repeats merge). Tell the user when you file one. It changes nothing itself: the workspace owner reviews it, or the fastn team for a global skill, a fastn-managed connector or the gateway. Name the `skill` it is about, or the `connector` when no skill owns it. With a concrete fix to a skill's text, add `edit` (an exact replacement, as in save_skill) so the owner can apply it in one click. Pass `task` to link the run. Never include private message content.

skill.description: The skill slug the feedback is about. Required unless `connector` is given.

connector.description: The app/connector slug involved, for feedback no skill owns (e.g. an error).

problem.description: What went wrong or blocked the user, briefly.

correction.description: The user's correction in their words, or what would have fixed it.

edit.description: Optional fix to the skill's text: one exact replacement the owner can apply.

old_string.description: The exact current text, copied from the skill; must be unique.

task.description: The run's trace id (the `_task` you passed on its tool calls).

source.description: "human" when the user raised it, else "agent" (default).

kind.description: "skill" correction (default when skill is set), "error" for a tool/connection failure (default when only connector is set), or "other" (e.g. a missing capability).
